Ivern.combo: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is used and Ivern E Triggerseed bursts, find a wall angle and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow up with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks to land both hits of Q. If you need to interrupt the enemy’s counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict without charging it.
Ivern.fight: Close the gap right after Ivern Q Rootcaller misses, but don’t dash onto a target already marked by Ivern E Triggerseed. Before starting a fight with Poppy E Heroic Charge, position so there is a wall behind the enemy.
Ivern.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the announced target area. Your allies following up on crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy! is more dangerous than Ivern’s own damage, so consider tenacity first. If building resistance against Ivern’s magic damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Ivern.escape: Immediately after Ivern Q Rootcaller is no longer available is your window to close the gap. If Ivern dashes in with Q, stop him with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then look for a wall angle with Poppy E Heroic Charge after Q has been fully spent. If Ivern E Triggerseed is on a target, engage after the shield bursts.
Ivern.laning: While taking ranged poke, use the extended range of Poppy P Iron Ambassador to poke and last-hit, and safely pick up the dropped buckler to gain a shield. Don’t use Poppy E Heroic Charge recklessly while Ivern Q Rootcaller is still available. Watch for an ambush when passing beside a suddenly appearing patch of brush created by Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, pressure Ivern while Ivern Q Rootcaller is down.
Ivern.teamfight: Wait at the entrance to your backline and stop the dash following Ivern Q Rootcaller with Poppy W Steadfast Presence; if you have a wall angle, stun the target with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Ivern R Daisy! repeatedly attacks you, reposition to avoid her knockup. When targeting an ally carrying Ivern E Triggerseed, engage after the shield bursts, and don’t chase Ivern himself too far.
Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so avoid the line by keeping minions or terrain in between before firing. Ivern E Triggerseed leaves a slow after it bursts on its target, so don’t engage immediately. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid her repeated attacks and knockups.

Aatrox.laning: Early on, avoid giving up kills, collect CS, and dodge the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. When he steps forward to last-hit, look for a Poppy E Heroic Charge angle against a wall; if there is none, poke only with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Aatrox.phase: Early on, Poppy’s Poppy Q Hammer Shock has a long cooldown, and she does not have Poppy E Heroic Charge yet, so avoid forcing fights. Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, you can pressure him around walls. In the mid to late game, make use of your growing durability to protect allies instead of trying to finish duels with raw damage.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Aatrox heals while fighting with Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and Aatrox R World Ender. If the fight drags on, build resistances, then buy Executioner's Calling to reduce his healing. Consider armor penetration if your damage is low.
Aatrox.combo: Position so Poppy, Aatrox, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun him by pinning him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and an auto attack to land both hits of Q. If you need to interrupt Aatrox’s counterattack, cast Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately without charging it.
Aatrox.escape: The moment after Aatrox uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash is a chance to close the gap. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, focus first on leaving its area; save Poppy E Heroic Charge if you need it to escape. When there is a safe opening to engage, close in with Poppy E Heroic Charge and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to prevent his escape.
Aatrox.fight: Use the brief window after Aatrox uses the empowered attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion to trade. If you have an angle to pin him against a wall, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then hit Poppy Q Hammer Shock and an auto attack. If Aatrox E Umbral Dash is available, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence and use it when you see him dash.
Aatrox.teamfight: Stand where you can stop Aatrox from reaching your backline. Watch for Aatrox E Umbral Dash and block it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence; if a wall angle opens up, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately to interrupt his counterattack, or charge it to knock enemies far away.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is dangerous at the blade’s edge, so when you see the cast animation, dodge outside its outer range or move in close. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, walk out of its area immediately. When Aatrox R World Ender activates, create distance and let its duration run out.

Gangplank.watch: As Gangplank E Powder Keg primes, the risk of an explosion rises, so avoid nearby old barrels and spots where two barrels overlap. If you can hit a barrel directly from outside the blast radius, destroy it. Don’t rely on a stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge while Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available.
Gangplank.build: Build armor first from the laning phase against the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and E Powder Keg. Resistances can’t block the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire or R Cannon Barrage, so get health too. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy healing makes the fight drag on, reduce it with Executioner’s Calling.
Gangplank.combo: After Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge when Poppy, Gangplank, and a wall are in a straight line. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks to land both hits from Q. If you need to stop Gangplank’s counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately without charging it.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so if Gangplank E Powder Keg was just placed and Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, you have an opportunity to engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed or Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available, reconsider your engage angle.
Gangplank.fight: The moment after Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg, while it’s still unprimed, is your chance to close in and trade damage. Use Poppy E Heroic Charge when there’s a wall behind Gangplank to aim for a stun. If there’s no angle, save it and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Back off if there’s a primed barrel nearby.
Gangplank.laning: When Gangplank steps forward to last-hit and there’s a wall behind him, look for an angle to use Poppy E Heroic Charge. Look to fight just after he places Gangplank E Powder Keg, and keep your distance near a primed barrel.
Gangplank.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, look to fight based on the state of Gangplank E Powder Keg.
Gangplank.teamfight: Wait for the enemy to engage near your backline, stop the engage with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then look for an angle to slam the enemy into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage is available to choose when to fight over objectives. If you need to send an enemy far away, charge Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to split the teamfight.

Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius before it explodes. If you’re near the barrel when Gragas E Body Slam hits too, you’ll take both abilities, so stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. When Gragas has Gragas R Explosive Cask ready, don’t stand with your back to an enemy turret.
Gragas.build: Gragas’ main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Since Gragas W Drunken Rage scales with maximum health, avoid stacking health alone. If healing from Gragas P Happy Hour is a concern, reduce it with Executioner’s Calling.
Gragas.combo: When a wall-stun angle opens, hit Gragas into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. You can also land Q’s follow-up explosion during the stun, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge first when you have this angle. If you need to stop Gragas’ counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict without charging it.
Gragas.escape: Immediately after you force Gragas to use Gragas E Body Slam is Poppy’s window to go in. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence stopped the dash, check for a wall angle and close in with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Gragas E may come back up, so don’t chase deep unless you can secure the kill.
Gragas.fight: While Gragas E Body Slam is available, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop the dash. Right after Gragas uses E, close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge, but only when you have an angle to hit him into a wall. While Gragas drinks with Gragas W Drunken Rage, hold your burst and deal damage after the damage reduction ends.
Gragas.laning: When Gragas steps up to last-hit, look for an angle where Poppy, Gragas, and a wall are in a straight line. If there’s no angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Don’t stand on top of a rolled Gragas Q Barrel Roll.
Gragas.phase: Early on, Poppy Q Hammer Shock has a long cooldown, and before learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, Poppy has limited engage. In the early and mid game, beware Gragas’ burst and ability to disrupt your formation, and keep your formation in objective fights. As the game goes on, Poppy gets tankier and Gragas’ sustained damage weakens, so in the late game protect your damage dealers instead of focusing on dealing damage.
Gragas.teamfight: Stand in the path of Gragas E Body Slam as it approaches your backline and stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If a wall angle opens, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately if you need to stop his counterattack. If Gragas E hits you, move outside the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll instead of counterattacking in place.

Akali.escape: Your chance to engage comes when Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip are down, or especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes off cooldown. If only one mobility ability is down, she can still escape with the other, so do not chase too soon. When an opening comes, find a wall angle, close in with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to prevent her escape.
Akali.teamfight: Stand in Akali’s path as she moves toward your backline and interrupt her dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Then pin her against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun her, and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to knock her away from allies if needed. When an ally damage dealer is being targeted, do not use Poppy E Heroic Charge to engage first.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance and health first to handle Akali’s main damage. Health is especially important because the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution deals more damage based on your missing health. Consider movement speed to help you get out of telegraphed attack areas.
Akali.combo: From an angle where Poppy, Akali, and a wall are in a straight line, stun her against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then hit Poppy Q Hammer Shock and an auto attack. If Akali counterattacks, interrupt her with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict without charging it.
Akali.fight: When Akali steps forward to last-hit or comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to engage, look for a Poppy E Heroic Charge angle against a wall and trade back. If there is no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Keep Poppy W Steadfast Presence ready while Akali still has a dash available.
Akali.laning: After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to pin Akali against the wall beside the lane when she steps up to last-hit.
Akali.phase: In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable for her durability, while her raw damage falls behind, so protect allies instead of hunting for kills.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip. Once marked, you cannot escape the second dash even if you run, so interrupt her when she dashes in with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. You cannot walk out of the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution, so save Poppy W Steadfast Presence for it, and watch out for the second hit, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Fiddlesticks.phase: In the mid to late game, focus on protecting your team and stopping Fiddlesticks from engaging rather than dealing more damage.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm deals area damage as he moves after channeling. If you see him cast it, interrupt him with Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict; if you can’t, get out of range. Skills that hit you from outside your vision cause fear, so watch for bush ambushes when Fiddlesticks is out of sight.
Fiddlesticks.build: If Fiddlesticks’ healing is a problem, get Executioner's Calling to reduce it. Build magic resistance rather than armor against his damage. It’s also important to use the movement speed from Poppy W Steadfast Presence to leave warned attack areas.
Fiddlesticks.combo: At an angle that lines up Poppy, Fiddlesticks, and a wall, stun him by pushing him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there’s no angle at a wall, don’t use Poppy E Heroic Charge too early.
Fiddlesticks.escape: While Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, you have an opportunity to engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge. You can also close the gap with less concern about crowd control right after Fiddlesticks uses Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap. If Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is being cast, first check whether you can interrupt it before engaging.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, interrupt the channel with Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, which you’ve saved for this moment.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Instead of forcing an engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge, poke and farm with the extra range from Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Walk in to close the gap right after Fiddlesticks uses a poke ability, and pick up the dropped buckler for a shield when it’s safe. Keep vision in the bush behind your lane, and don’t pass by an unverified Scarecrow Effigy.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Space out from your team so several allies aren’t hit by Fiddlesticks’ area abilities, and don’t bunch up in narrow corridors without vision. Also use crowd control to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest when its channel begins.

Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility spell, so if the empowered attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike has been expended and you have an angle to pin him against a wall, engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Garen has just activated Garen W Courage, wait until the moment he gains the shield and tenacity has passed before using Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Garen.fight: Start a short trade right after Garen uses his empowered attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike on a minion or it is expended. If you have an angle to pin him against a wall, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge and then attack; otherwise, poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador and save E. If you see Garen start the animation for Garen W Courage, delay Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict by half a beat before using it.
Garen.phase: In the mid game, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to join skirmishes and team fights. Garen W Courage’s scaling stacks make the matchup harder as time goes on, so limit his scaling early. In the late game, focus on protecting your team rather than dealing damage.
Garen.teamfight: Wait in front of your backline for the enemy to engage, and stop their dashes with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Pin enemies who engage against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to protect your damage dealers, and knock them away with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict if needed. When an ally damage dealer is being targeted, don’t use E to dive far ahead first.
Garen.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Armor can’t reduce Garen R Demacian Justice, so get health too. If you need to reduce healing from Garen P Perseverance, consider Executioner’s Calling.
Garen.combo: Position so Poppy, Garen, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks to land both hits from Q. Delay this combo when Garen W Courage’s shield and tenacity activate.
Garen.laning: Early on, look for an angle to push Garen into the wall beside the lane when he steps up to last-hit. If there’s no wall-stun angle for Poppy E Heroic Charge, don’t force an engage, and create distance while Garen E Judgment is spinning. Push and pressure the lane to limit Garen’s opportunities to build Garen W Courage’s growth stacks. After shoving the wave, create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his next basic attack and silences, so don’t engage first while it’s active. You lose out the longer you stay close to Garen E Judgment, so trade briefly and get out of its spin range. If health is below half, beware Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on missing health; don’t stay within its range.

Briar.build: Briar’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. It’s also important to dodge Briar Q Head Rush, which shreds your resistances. If the matchup turns into extended fights where Briar can heal, buy Executioner’s Calling after your resistance item to reduce her healing.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in and shreds your resistances, so watch your distance to avoid getting hit. Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and Briar R Certain Death dashes. If Briar charges Briar E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with a stun or knockup, and avoid standing with your back to a wall in case the scream is fully charged.
Briar.combo: Position so Poppy, Briar, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun her against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and an auto attack to aim for both hits of Q during the stun. If Briar starts charging Briar E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Poppy E Heroic Charge’s stun or the knockup from an immediate Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
Briar.escape: Do not go in immediately just because only one of Briar Q Head Rush and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is down. Check her remaining mobility and Briar E Chilling Scream’s stun, and close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge especially before Briar R Certain Death comes back up. Follow with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to prevent Briar from escaping.
Briar.fight: When Briar steps forward to last-hit, stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge from a wall angle. If there is no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Keep Poppy W Steadfast Presence ready while Briar has a dash available.
Briar.laning: Early on, Poppy Q Hammer Shock has a long cooldown, and you do not have Poppy E Heroic Charge yet, so avoid forcing fights. If you have pushed the lane, get vision so you can counterattack Briar’s reckless engages, and do not stand for long in the middle of the lane without vision. After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to pin her against the wall beside the lane.
Briar.phase: Early on, Briar has high kill participation, while Poppy has little ability to force fights before learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, so do not linger without vision. After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge and getting a shorter cooldown on Poppy Q Hammer Shock, look for melee fights with a wall stun.
Briar.teamfight: Stand in front of Briar as she heads for your backline, keeping the target of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack on the frontline and making sure Briar R Certain Death’s first target is not a backline damage dealer. Block her path with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and use Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept with a wall stun instead of engaging first. If Briar charges Briar E Chilling Scream, you can interrupt it with the knockup from an immediate Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.

Ekko.phase: Once you’ve learned Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown starts getting shorter in the mid game, look for close fights when you have an angle to pin Ekko against a wall. Poppy gets tankier later, but her raw damage falls behind, so focus on protecting your team instead of assuming who is stronger between you and Ekko.
Ekko.build: If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak is a problem, get Executioner's Calling to reduce it. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s main damage. If you have no mobility to dodge the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence, consider tenacity first.
Ekko.combo: When there’s a wall behind Ekko, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then attack with Poppy Q Hammer Shock followed by basic attacks. If you need to interrupt Ekko’s counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict without charging it.
Ekko.escape: Engage in earnest after both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. If Ekko E Phase Dive is also down, close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge and look for a stun. Take the opportunity to follow up with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up.
Ekko.fight: Stop Ekko’s dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence as he comes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. If his mobility is down and there’s a wall behind him, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge and fight. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don’t chase too far just because one other mobility ability is down.
Ekko.laning: When Ekko steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle that lines up Poppy, Ekko, and a wall. If there’s no angle at a wall, save Poppy E Heroic Charge, and keep Poppy W Steadfast Presence ready while Ekko E Phase Dive is available.
Ekko.teamfight: Stand in a path where you can stop Ekko E Phase Dive as he approaches your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Right after Ekko gets in, his mobility is down, so lock him down with a wall stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to force Ekko R Chronobreak or stop his engage. If your carry is being targeted, save Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept instead of using it to engage first.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Also move out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see an afterimage behind Ekko, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t overextend to chase him, even at low health.

Trundle.watch: Trundle gains attack speed and healing while inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, so don’t fight there for long; back off and let its duration run out. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks narrow paths and slows, so move to the side immediately when the pillar appears. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on your max health and steals your resistances, so create distance while it is active.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and basic attacks. If healing from Trundle P King's Tribute is a problem, apply Grievous Wounds with Executioner's Calling. Trundle R Subjugate steals resistances and deals damage based on your max health, so don’t try to counter it by stacking only resistances or health; create distance while it’s active.
Trundle.combo: From an angle that lines up Poppy, Trundle, and a wall, slam him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks to hit both instances of Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s damage. If Trundle retaliates, you can use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately to knock him up and interrupt him.
Trundle.escape: Your opening comes after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and the duration of Trundle W Frozen Domain ends. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you have a wall angle, catch him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Trundle R Subjugate is active, don’t engage during it; create distance.
Trundle.fight: Start fights outside Trundle W Frozen Domain. When Trundle steps forward to last-hit and you have a wall angle, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then make a short trade with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If you don’t have a wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Trundle.laning: Trundle P King's Tribute heals him when nearby units die, so don’t let a fight drag on in front of a large wave while you only chip away at his health. If you’ve dealt damage, take an advantage right away or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and can use Poppy Q Hammer Shock more often, look for short trades using a wall.
Trundle.teamfight: Stand along the path enemies take to your backline, stop their dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and push them into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun them. If you’re hit by Trundle R Subjugate, don’t keep fighting Trundle; create distance or switch to another target.

Zac.phase: In the mid to late game, focus on protecting your allies rather than dealing damage as Poppy.
Zac.build: Consider Executioner’s Calling early to reduce healing from Zac P Cell Division. Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against damage from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot.
Zac.combo: Stun Zac by charging him into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then hit him with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If you keep Zac in Q’s area with the stun, you can land the delayed damage too.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used, take advantage of the opening while he has no mobility and close the distance with Poppy E Heroic Charge. You can immediately use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to knock him up before he escapes again.
Zac.fight: Look to close the distance right after you force Zac to use E Elastic Slingshot or stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If there’s a wall behind Zac, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge and fight. During the trade, step on the blobs Zac leaves behind to prevent him from healing.
Zac.laning: When Zac steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle to push him into the wall beside the lane with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there’s no wall angle, save E and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Keep Poppy W Steadfast Presence available while Zac E Elastic Slingshot is ready.
Zac.teamfight: Stop Zac’s dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence as he enters with E Elastic Slingshot, then protect your backline by charging him into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before dashing and knocking you up. Dodge when you see the charge, or interrupt it with Poppy E Heroic Charge or R Keeper’s Verdict. Once the dash starts, stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. After Zac gets close, create distance so you don’t keep taking damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, which deals damage based on your maximum health.

Amumu.build: Build magic resistance against Amumu’s magic damage, and avoid building only large amounts of health because of Amumu W Despair. The true damage from Amumu P Cursed Touch cannot be reduced with resistances.
Amumu.combo: Position so Poppy, Amumu, and a wall are in a straight line, then pin him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge and follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and a basic attack. The remaining area of Q detonates during E’s stun, so when you have a wall angle, use E before Q. If you need to interrupt Amumu’s counterattack, cast Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately without charging it.
Amumu.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. If a wall angle opens up, pin him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to interrupt his counterattack if needed. If Q is still available, prepare to stop his engage with Poppy W Steadfast Presence instead of going in first.
Amumu.fight: When Amumu steps forward to last-hit, trade by stunning him with Poppy E Heroic Charge from a wall angle. If there is no wall angle, save E and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador; keep Poppy W Steadfast Presence ready for when Amumu Q Bandage Toss brings him in. After landing Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s damage near Amumu, adjust your distance so you are not exposed to Amumu W Despair for long.
Amumu.laning: Move unpredictably behind minions so Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits and gets blocked by the first target it reaches. When Amumu steps up to last-hit, look for a Poppy E Heroic Charge angle to pin him against the wall beside the lane. If there is no angle, do not use E; poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Amumu.phase: After Amumu learns Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, he can start fights against grouped allies, so keep your distance. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable for her durability, while her raw damage falls behind, so focus on protecting your damage dealers.
Amumu.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies and fight in open areas to prevent Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy from hitting multiple allies. Block Amumu’s approach with Poppy W Steadfast Presence when he comes in with Amumu Q Bandage Toss, and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge if a wall angle opens up. Start the full fight after Amumu R is down, and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to knock enemies away from your backline if needed.
Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, you are caught, and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy also stuns nearby allies. Stand behind minions to dodge the bandage, and do not group with allies while Amumu has R available. Amumu W Despair continuously deals damage based on your maximum health to nearby enemies, so do not stay close to him for long.

Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Also get movement speed to leave telegraphed areas. If the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling to reduce it.
Aurora.combo: Position so Poppy, Aurora, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun her against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you need to interrupt her counterattack, cast Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately without charging it.
Aurora.escape: Your chance to engage comes when Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are both down, and before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up. Close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge then, but check for a wall angle. If Aurora dashes with a mobility ability she has saved, watch for it and press Poppy W Steadfast Presence to block her.
Aurora.fight: Immediately after dodging Aurora’s poke, walk closer and save Poppy E Heroic Charge for a chance to pin her against a wall. Aurora can escape with Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, or Aurora R Between Worlds, so do not go deep just because one mobility ability is down. Block her dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence to create a chance to close in.
Aurora.laning: Do not force your way onto ranged Aurora with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Poke with the increased range of Poppy P Iron Ambassador while collecting CS. If you can safely pick up the fallen buckler, use its shield to stay in lane longer, but do not force a pickup if it lands near Aurora. When your health is low, keep Aurora Q Twofold Hex’s recall damage in mind and keep trades short.
Aurora.phase: In the mid to late game, use Poppy’s increased durability to focus on protecting allies over competing in damage.
Aurora.teamfight: Stand in Aurora’s path as she moves toward your backline and block the dashes from Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, and Aurora R Between Worlds with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Then pin her against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun her, and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to interrupt her counterattack or knock her far away if needed. If Aurora gets a takedown, her leap ability’s cooldown resets, so do not leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, it deals damage again when recalled, with more damage the lower your health is. If you are cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself, and if your health is borderline, retreat before the recall. Once Aurora R Between Worlds creates its area, you are slowed when leaving, so decide whether to get out before it appears or fight inside.

Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal her main physical damage, so build armor first. Consider defensive items that reduce attack speed to deal with Bel'Veth’s basic attacks and attack speed. If the healing from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling to reduce it.
Belveth.combo: Position so Poppy, Bel'Veth, and a wall are in a straight line, then pin her against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, wait for it to end before using damage abilities.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below to the side, and look to engage immediately after Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is spent. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, but it comes back quickly, so chain Poppy E Heroic Charge’s stun into Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to limit her time to escape.
Belveth.fight: Right after Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down, look for an angle to pin her against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If the stun lands, trade with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and a basic attack, and save Poppy W Steadfast Presence for her next dash.
Belveth.laning: When Bel'Veth steps forward to last-hit, look for a Poppy E Heroic Charge angle against a wall. If there is no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. If Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet is still available, do not use Poppy W Steadfast Presence first.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth is weak early, so Poppy should slow her growth by contesting early encounters and camps. Poppy can force stronger melee fights after learning Poppy E Heroic Charge and getting a shorter cooldown on Poppy Q Hammer Shock. As time passes, stacks of Bel'Veth P Death in Lavender remain and make Bel'Veth stronger, so in the late game Poppy should focus on protecting allies rather than dealing damage.
Belveth.teamfight: Block Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet as she enters your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge if a wall angle opens up. Interrupt Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom by knocking her up with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, or save damage abilities until it ends. If an ally dies and leaves a Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth picks it up, and delay teamfights while Bel'Veth is transformed.
Belveth.watch: Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to block Bel'Veth when she dashes in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge or Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet. If she gets close, sidestep Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Bel'Veth takes greatly reduced damage while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, so save Poppy Q Hammer Shock until it ends.

Brand.build: Brand’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Since Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, also get movement speed to help you leave telegraphed attack areas rather than building only large amounts of health.
Brand.combo: When there is a wall behind Brand, stun him against it with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then attack with Poppy Q Hammer Shock followed by an auto attack. Do not cast Poppy Q Hammer Shock first, since its area detonates while he is stunned. If you need to interrupt Brand’s counterattack during a duel, cast Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately without charging it.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so the moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to engage. If Brand P Blaze is applied to you, dodge Brand Q Sear’s stun before going in. Use Poppy E Heroic Charge to close the gap during that window.
Brand.fight: Immediately after dodging Brand W Pillar of Flame, walk closer and save Poppy E Heroic Charge. Engage when there is a wall behind Brand and Poppy and Brand are lined up toward it. Brand has relatively low armor, so Poppy’s physical damage is effective.
Brand.laning: Do not force your way onto ranged Brand with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Poke with the increased range of Poppy P Iron Ambassador while collecting CS. Do not last-hit beside a burning minion; stand off to the side of the wave. If you can safely pick up the fallen buckler, use its shield to hold the lane.
Brand.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and can cast Poppy Q Hammer Shock more often, look for chances to engage after Brand uses a poke ability. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more durable while her raw damage falls behind, so focus on protecting your damage dealers.
Brand.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies to limit the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces of Brand R Pyroclasm, and do not stand beside burning allies. Move away from allies when you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast. If an ally damage dealer is being targeted, save Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept instead of using it to engage first.
Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand Q Sear first. If Brand Q Sear hits you while Brand P Blaze is applied, you will be stunned, so get out of the projectile’s path or hide behind minions. Also watch for Brand E Conflagration to spread near burning minions.

Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage. Armor cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, but be careful about building only large amounts of health because Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your maximum health. If Camille W Tactical Sweep’s healing is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling to reduce it.
Camille.combo: Position so Poppy, Camille, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun her against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and an auto attack to land both hits of Q, and walk over to collect your buckler if it lands nearby.
Camille.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Camille E Hookshot is down and before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up. Find a wall angle and approach with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then follow with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. If only Camille E Hookshot is down, she can escape with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, so do not rush the chase.
Camille.fight: When Camille steps forward to last-hit, start a trade by pinning her against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge if you have an angle. If there is no angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador; keep Poppy W Steadfast Presence ready while Camille E Hookshot is available.
Camille.laning: Stand away from walls, between minions, and avoid positions where Camille E Hookshot can drive you toward a wall. Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates; engage after the shield has been removed. Take lane control and pressure her farming before Camille’s first core item is completed, while she is weak.
Camille.phase: After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, pressure Camille with wall angles and disrupt her farming to delay her first core item. In the mid game, do not leave side lanes open, so you can stop Camille from quickly destroying towers. In the late game, focus on protecting your backline over Poppy’s damage.
Camille.teamfight: Interrupt Camille E Hookshot’s leap as she moves toward your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Then, if a wall angle opens up, stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge to protect your damage dealers. Do not use Poppy E Heroic Charge to go in far ahead of your team and leave your backline behind.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot can reach you even when you are far from the wall, so if her hook catches a wall, interrupt her leap with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. The second empowered basic attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol deals some true damage, so create distance while she prepares it. Do not waste crowd control as Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum begins; if you are trapped, hold out until the zone ends, then counterattack.

Chogath.build: Consider Executioner's Calling first to reduce the healing from Cho'Gath P Carnivore. Build magic resistance against the damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Resistance won’t stop the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, and building only large amounts of health also increases the max-health-based damage from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes.
Chogath.combo: Position so Poppy, Cho'Gath, and a wall are in a line, then stun him by pushing him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow up with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks to land both hits of Poppy Q Hammer Shock. You can use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately to interrupt Cho'Gath’s counterattack.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility, so look to engage immediately after he uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave or you dodge it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream’s silence is also down, that’s a good window to use Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you’re silenced, walk out of the frontal area first instead of trying to cast abilities.
Chogath.fight: After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to push Cho'Gath toward a wall and stun him as he steps up to last-hit. An opening comes after you dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture or right after he uses it on the wave. If there’s no angle for a wall stun, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Chogath.laning: Step out of the line of Cho'Gath’s basic attacks so Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes can’t hit both you and the minions. After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, pressure him by using his last-hit path and the wall beside the lane, and limit the time he has to stack early.
Chogath.phase: You can make use of Poppy R Keeper's Verdict in the mid game, but the longer the game goes and the more stacks Cho'Gath gains, the worse the matchup becomes. In the late game, keep your distance when your health is borderline to avoid being killed by Cho'Gath R Feast, and focus on protecting your team in fights instead of dealing damage.
Chogath.teamfight: Watch for Cho'Gath approaching near your backline, and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have an angle at a wall. Use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately to interrupt a counterattack, or charge it to knock Cho'Gath far away and remove him from the teamfight. Poppy W Steadfast Presence stops dashes, but Cho'Gath has no mobility, so don’t use it preemptively to stop his engage.
Chogath.watch: When the warning appears beneath you for Cho'Gath Q Rupture, immediately walk to the side to dodge it. If you’re hit by the frontal silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, you can’t escape with Poppy E Heroic Charge, so stay out of his frontal area and first walk out of it while silenced. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions, so step out of the line of his basic attacks. If your health is at or below half, keep your distance and watch out for the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.

Darius.build: Build armor first to deal with Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Get health as well to account for Darius E Apprehend’s penetration and Darius R Noxian Guillotine’s true damage. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate is a problem, get Executioner's Calling to reduce it; add penetration if your damage isn’t getting through.
Darius.combo: Position so Poppy, Darius, and a wall are in a line, then stun him by slamming him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there’s no angle for a wall stun, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Darius.escape: When Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, you have a window to trade. If Darius P Hemorrhage is stacking, stop engaging and create distance.
Darius.fight: After Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, take a short trade when you can push Darius toward a wall as he steps up to last-hit. When you see the blade of Darius Q Decimate, move out of its range or stay very close, and end the trade before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up. While Darius R Noxian Guillotine is down, you can close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Darius.laning: If there’s no angle for a wall stun, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador, but don’t overextend to pick up the dropped buckler. Look for an opening right after Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions or Darius E Apprehend misses.
Darius.phase: Early on, Poppy’s poke and engage are weak, while Darius is strong in chaotic skirmishes, so look for short trades only. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but loses out in raw damage, so focus on protecting your carries.
Darius.teamfight: Stand in the path of enemies approaching your backline, use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop their dashes, and stun them against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Save Poppy W Steadfast Presence so you can use it as Darius dashes in with Darius R Noxian Guillotine. Use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately to interrupt a counterattack, or charge it to knock enemies far away and split the teamfight.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you’ll take follow-up attacks, so harass from outside its range and approach after it misses. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s range or stay very close to reduce its damage and healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up, create distance to break the stacks, and don’t stay within Darius R Noxian Guillotine range while several stacks are on you.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first to deal with the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If the duel goes long, get Executioner's Calling to reduce the healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is still available, first use a quick tap of Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to trigger his passive and have it negate that first immobilizing effect. Then line up Poppy, Dr. Mundo, and a wall, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and follow up with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. Poppy E Heroic Charge won’t stun him unless it hits a wall, so don’t use it without an angle.
DrMundo.escape: After Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by a minion or misses, you have a chance to close the gap. Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, but before engaging, check whether you can make him use Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases and whether you have an angle at a wall.
DrMundo.fight: Look for an angle near a wall when Dr. Mundo steps forward to last-hit. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so make him use it first, then stun him against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge and trade with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If there’s no angle at a wall, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
DrMundo.laning: Stand behind minions to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. Step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops as you retreat to stop its healing and passive cooldown reduction. Before learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, your engage is weak, so avoid forced trades.
DrMundo.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, you can pressure him when you have an angle at a wall. In the late game, Poppy’s defensive ability matters more than her damage; if Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is ready, look for other advantages instead of committing to killing him.
DrMundo.teamfight: Stand where you can stop enemies approaching your backline, and use Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept them. Instead of spending a long time attacking Dr. Mundo while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, stop other enemies from engaging and protect your carries. When you need to knock an enemy away, account for the direction they’ll be sent by Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target it strikes and deals damage based on current health, so dodge it with minions between you and him. Don’t spend time trying to kill Dr. Mundo while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, since it grants healing and movement speed.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main ability damage. Also get armor to deal with her basic attack damage, and consider tenacity if you struggle to survive after being hit by Elise E Cocoon.
Elise.combo: Position so Poppy, Elise, and a wall are in a line, then stun her by pushing her into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow up with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks to land both hits of Poppy Q Hammer Shock. If you need to interrupt a counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately without charging it.
Elise.escape: Counter-engage after confirming that both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down. In particular, right after Elise uses Elise Q Venomous Bite, you have a chance to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Elise.fight: When harassed from range, keep your distance and apply pressure with Poppy P Iron Ambassador, then walk in to close the gap right after Elise has used her poke ability. React to the dash from Elise Q Venomous Bite with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Use Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have an angle to stun her against a wall.
Elise.laning: Keep plenty of vision early, and don’t push the lane too far when Elise is out of sight. Stand behind minions to block Elise E Cocoon, and farm and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. If the dropped buckler is on Elise’s side, don’t overextend to pick it up.
Elise.phase: Early on, watch for Elise’s ganks and focus on avoiding deaths. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, so focus on protecting your team over dealing damage.
Elise.teamfight: Stop Elise Q Venomous Bite when she dives toward your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Then stun her against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to knock her away if needed. If your carry is being targeted, don’t use Poppy E Heroic Charge to engage first.
Elise.watch: Elise E Cocoon stuns the first unit it hits, so stand behind minions to avoid it. At full health, watch especially for Elise Q Neurotoxin; once health has decreased and Elise switches to R Spider Form, watch especially for Elise Q Venomous Bite. Stop Elise’s dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence when she uses Elise Q Venomous Bite.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn’s main damage. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, and Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on max health, so avoid relying on stacking health; move away before the mark matures. If the healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade is a problem, get Executioner's Calling to reduce it.
Evelynn.combo: Position so Poppy, Evelynn, and a wall are in a line, then stun her by slamming her into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you need to interrupt a counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately without charging it.
Evelynn.escape: Back away before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, and look for a chance to counterattack after stopping the dash from Evelynn E Whiplash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress, so look especially for an opening before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up. Then close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge and catch her with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, and react to the dash from Evelynn E Whiplash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up, look for an angle by a wall and try to stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there’s no angle at a wall, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Evelynn.laning: Carry a Control Ward, and place vision near the jungle camp where Evelynn starts fights. In lane, look for an angle to push Evelynn into a wall to the side when she steps forward; if there’s no angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Evelynn.phase: In the mid to late game, Poppy gets tankier but loses out in raw damage, so focus on protecting your carries instead of dealing damage.
Evelynn.teamfight: Guard Evelynn’s approach near your backline, and time Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop the dash from Evelynn E Whiplash. Catch Evelynn after she engages with a wall stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge or the knockup from Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. If your carry is being targeted, save Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept instead of using it to engage first.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back away before the charm lands and alert your team. Evelynn E Whiplash deals heavy damage after the charm, so watch her likely approach path and stop her dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. At low health, Evelynn R Last Caress deals much more damage, so don’t stay in areas without vision.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Armor can’t block the true damage from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance or Fiora R Grand Challenge. Since Fiora R Grand Challenge scales with your maximum health, be wary of stacking health alone. If healing is a concern in a prolonged duel, build resistances, then reduce her healing with Executioner’s Calling.
Fiora.combo: Once Fiora W Riposte is down, if Poppy, Fiora, and a wall are in a straight line, stun her against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. While she’s stunned, you can also land the area explosion from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge first when you have a wall-stun angle. Don’t rush this combo while Fiora W Riposte is available.
Fiora.escape: Right after you force Fiora to use Fiora Q Lunge, you have a chance to close the gap. Stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, or confirm Fiora Q Lunge is down; if Fiora W Riposte is also down, go in with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you follow up with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict at that point, Fiora cannot escape.
Fiora.fight: Stand on the side opposite where Fiora’s Vital appears, and briefly counterattack when Fiora moves toward the Vital. If Fiora Q Lunge is available, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence and use it to stop her dash. Bait out Fiora W Riposte, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have an angle to push her into a wall.
Fiora.laning: When Fiora steps up to last-hit, look for an angle with a wall nearby. If there isn’t one, poke only with Poppy P Iron Ambassador and save Poppy E Heroic Charge. After a short trade, don’t chase recklessly.
Fiora.teamfight: Wait at a chokepoint leading to your backline and stop Fiora Q Lunge with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If a wall angle opens, stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge. While Fiora W Riposte is available, use Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict carefully, and dodge the counter-thrust sideways. If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, hug a wall so she can’t reach all four vitals.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main damage from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, Gnar E Hop / Crunch, and Gnar R GNAR!. Remember that the magic damage from Gnar W Hyper / Wallop isn’t blocked by armor and scales with maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Gnar.combo: Position so there’s a wall behind Gnar, then push him into it with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him and follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If you don’t have an angle that will put him against a wall, don’t use Poppy E Heroic Charge expecting a stun.
Gnar.escape: The moment after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down is Poppy’s window to go in. When his only mobility skill is down, close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge and use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to deny him time to escape. If Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch to jump near Poppy, stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence.
Gnar.fight: Fight right after Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar, taking advantage of the time when he can’t transform again. Once Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, close the gap on foot or look for an angle to push him into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Right after he transforms into Mega Gnar, create distance and wait it out.
Gnar.laning: Early on, don’t force an engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge just to trade back against Mini Gnar’s ranged poke. Farm and poke with the increased range from Poppy P Iron Ambassador, and use the shield if you can safely pick up the dropped buckler. Immediately after dodging Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, close the gap on foot.
Gnar.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, you can fight when Gnar’s mobility is down.
Gnar.teamfight: Watch Gnar’s rage and don’t fight head-on right after he transforms into Mega Gnar. Fight with your team right after he returns to Mini Gnar. Avoid narrow terrain and positions with a wall behind you to guard against the wall stun from Gnar R GNAR!. In front of your backline, stop Gnar E Hop / Crunch’s engage with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then push him into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to protect your team.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit both when it’s thrown and when it returns in Mini form, so step out of its path. When Gnar’s rage is building and transformation is near, avoid direct fights. Don’t stand with your back to a wall where Mega Gnar R GNAR! can knock and stun you.

Graves.build: Graves’ main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Remember that the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen isn’t blocked by armor.
Graves.combo: If you have an angle with Poppy, Graves, and a wall in a straight line, stun him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. You can land the second hit from Poppy Q Hammer Shock during the stun, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge first when you have a wall-stun angle.
Graves.escape: Don’t go in immediately just because only Graves E Quickdraw is down. Look for a window before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and once you’re close, stop his counterattack with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Graves.fight: Block Graves P New Destiny’s basic attacks with a minion or ally between you, and counterattack while Graves is reloading after firing two shots. While taking ranged poke, keep your distance and use Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Right after Graves misses a poke ability, walk in and look for an angle to use Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Graves.laning: Use the shield if you can safely pick up the dropped buckler, but don’t force an engage if it falls toward Graves. Push or pressure the lane from early on to limit Graves’ opportunities to build stacks on Graves E Quickdraw.
Graves.phase: In the mid game, once you’ve learned Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, you can look for chances to fight. Graves’ stacks make the matchup harder as time passes, so in the late game focus on protecting your damage dealers instead of competing in damage.
Graves.teamfight: Position to stop Graves E Quickdraw or Graves R Collateral Damage from reaching your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If a wall angle opens, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and stop a close counterattack with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict used immediately. When fighting, put a minion or ally between you and Graves to avoid his basic attacks.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line explodes instantly when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow passage. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave by the shortest route, then engage again. If Graves uses Graves E Quickdraw or Graves R Collateral Damage to dash near Poppy, stop him with Poppy W Steadfast Presence.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen’s primary damage, and get some armor as well to withstand her basic attacks. If healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts becomes a problem, reduce it with Executioner's Calling. Gwen has relatively high armor, so consider penetration if you need more damage.
Gwen.combo: When Poppy, Gwen, and a wall are in a straight line, push her into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun her, then follow up with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If you need to interrupt her counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately without charging it.
Gwen.escape: Right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used is an opportunity to engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Gwen.fight: Look for a trade near a wall before Gwen builds stacks of Q Snip Snip!, when she steps forward to last-hit. If Gwen uses E Skip 'n Slash to engage, stop her with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then push her into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge after her mobility is used. If there is no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Gwen.laning: After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to push Gwen into a wall beside the lane when she steps forward to last-hit. Around lots of minions, Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can come back quickly, so don’t chase her there.
Gwen.phase: The time before stacks are built up is an opportunity to trade. In the mid to late game, Poppy gets tankier but falls behind in raw damage, so focus on stopping the enemy damage dealers.
Gwen.teamfight: Stop Gwen E Skip 'n Slash as she heads for your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge if you have a wall angle. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on max health, so don’t rely on health alone to keep taking hits for a long time; build magic resistance, too. Move out of the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to knock Gwen away from your backline.
Gwen.watch: Walk sideways to dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, which deals true damage. If Gwen uses E Skip 'n Slash to close in, stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target her from outside the mist, so enter it or wait for it to end.

Hecarim.build: Hecarim’s main damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge is physical, so build armor first. If healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is a concern, reduce it with Executioner’s Calling, and finish the upgraded item when your build calls for defensive items.
Hecarim.combo: Position so Poppy, Hecarim, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Hecarim dashes in first, stop him with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then find a wall angle.
Hecarim.escape: Don’t rush in just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down; he can escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows. In particular, look for an opening before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up, close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then follow with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Hecarim.fight: Save Poppy W Steadfast Presence until Hecarim engages, then use it to stop his dash. Once Hecarim’s mobility is down, find a wall angle and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then deal a quick burst of damage. If there’s no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Hecarim.laning: When Hecarim steps up to last-hit, look for an angle to push him into the wall beside the lane. If there’s no angle, poke only with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Hecarim.phase: Starting when you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, look for trades that use walls. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but falls behind in raw damage, so focus on protecting your damage dealers.
Hecarim.teamfight: Wait for Hecarim to engage on your backline, stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then pin him against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Your allies should spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t fear them all together.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he runs, so watch for an engage even if he turns and starts running the other way. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear grouped allies all at once, so spread out in teamfights. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, he heals from damage dealt to nearby enemies, so don’t stay close and fight for long.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi’s main damage is physical, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on maximum health, so build armor first. Since Illaoi heals with Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, get healing reduction with Executioner’s Calling before building defensive items.
Illaoi.combo: When Poppy, Illaoi, and a wall are in a straight line, stun her against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. You can land the area explosion from Q during the stun, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge first when you have a wall angle.
Illaoi.escape: Immediately after you force Illaoi to use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is your chance to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, engage from the side without tentacles and use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to stop a counterattack if needed.
Illaoi.fight: If Illaoi dashes in with Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, stop her with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Immediately after Illaoi W is down, start a trade with Poppy E Heroic Charge from a spot away from the tentacles if you have an angle to push her into a wall.
Illaoi.laning: Illaoi can easily place tentacles near walls, so keep the wave away from walls and last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit range. If there’s no angle to hit her into a wall, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Illaoi.phase: In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but falls behind in raw damage, so focus on protecting your team.
Illaoi.teamfight: If your team groups in front of Illaoi, Illaoi R Leap of Faith creates more tentacles, so spread out. When she uses her ultimate, don’t give her targets to hit for its duration. Destroy the tentacles or draw Illaoi away from walls, while Poppy protects the backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence and Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Illaoi.watch: If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits you, its mark and slow put you under pressure, so stand out of range when last-hitting and dodge the incoming E. Illaoi R Leap of Faith is a high area-damage window, so when she uses it, move away and wait for its duration to end.

Irelia.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. If you want to reduce the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge, buy Executioner's Calling, and upgrade it further if the matchup calls for defensive items.
Irelia.combo: Position so Poppy, Irelia, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun her by slamming her into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you need to interrupt her counterattack in a duel, knock her up with an uncharged Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia Q Bladesurge goes on cooldown is an opportunity to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you stopped her Q dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, look for a wall stun while she briefly cannot use mobility abilities. Look for an engage after the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is no longer available, too.
Irelia.fight: Fight from an angle near a wall when Irelia steps forward to last-hit. If Irelia Q Bladesurge is available, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop the dash, or close the gap right after she uses Q. If there is no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia. Take a step back while minions are about to die and watch for Irelia Q Bladesurge to chain in.
Irelia.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Q’s cooldown gets shorter, use wall trades to disrupt Irelia’s farming. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable as a frontline presence but falls behind in raw damage, so focus on stopping Irelia’s engages.
Irelia.teamfight: Guard Irelia’s approach before she uses her area attacks and Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun in a teamfight. Stop Irelia Q Bladesurge as she dives onto your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then pin her to a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If needed, knock Irelia up or push her far away with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to separate her from your damage dealers.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain-dash through low-health minions to close the gap and heal, so create distance when minions are about to die. Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop Irelia Q Bladesurge as she dashes in. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If Irelia R Vanguard's Edge traps you, wait until the blades disappear.

JarvanIV.build: Basic attacks and attack speed are also a major source of his damage, so effects that reduce attack speed help.
JarvanIV.fight: If you don’t have an angle to stun the target against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, save E and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Then, if a wall angle opens up, stun the enemy with Poppy E Heroic Charge to protect your allied damage dealers.
JarvanIV.watch: When the dash starts, stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence.

Jax.build: Jax’s main damage comes from basic attacks and attack speed, so prioritize defensive effects that reduce attack speed. Jax deals both physical and magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, position so Poppy, Jax, and a wall are in a straight line. Stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then use Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks to land both hits of Q.
Jax.escape: When Jax E Counter Strike activates, stop basic attacking and move out of stun range. Stop Jax Q Leap Strike with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then reengage after Jax has spent Q and E has ended.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade after Jax E Counter Strike ends. If you stop Jax Q Leap Strike with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, or right after Jax uses Q, engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge if you have an angle to push him into a wall.
Jax.laning: After that, when Jax steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle to use Poppy E Heroic Charge near a wall. If there’s no angle, save E and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Pressure him with your jungler while Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown.
Jax.phase: In the late game, focus on Poppy’s tankiness and stopping engages over raw damage.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax dives onto your backline with Q Leap Strike, stop him with Poppy W Steadfast Presence and pin him to a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Don’t group up so you can avoid the area stun from Jax E Counter Strike, then chain crowd control after it ends.
Jax.watch: Stop basic attacking and move out of stun range while Jax E Counter Strike is active. When Jax comes in with Q Leap Strike, stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Magic resistance won’t stop the physical damage from Jayce Q Shock Blast, and Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer reduces resistances, so don’t rely on resistance alone to tank his attacks. Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on max health, so consider movement speed to escape its telegraphed attack instead of stacking health alone.
Jayce.combo: Position so there is a wall behind Jayce, then stun him by pushing him into it with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you need to interrupt Jayce’s counterattack, immediately use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict without charging it.
Jayce.escape: The opportunity to engage comes when you stop Jayce Q To the Skies! with Poppy W Steadfast Presence or right after Jayce uses the leap. Save Poppy E Heroic Charge to close the gap then, and interrupt Jayce’s counterattack with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Jayce.fight: Don’t recklessly engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge while Jayce pokes in Cannon Stance. If Jayce’s poke misses, walk in to close the gap, then engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge after Jayce Q To the Skies! is used. Poppy’s physical damage is effective against Jayce’s low armor.
Jayce.laning: Play defensively and last-hit in the early game, moving sideways to dodge the line of Jayce Q Shock Blast. Poke with the extended range of Poppy P Iron Ambassador, then safely pick up the dropped shield to use its shield. If health has been depleted, don’t force yourself to stay in lane; clear the wave, then return.
Jayce.phase: When Jayce is strong in the early game, farm defensively instead of forcing trades. In the mid to late game, make use of Poppy’s tankiness and focus on stopping enemy damage dealers rather than relying on damage alone.
Jayce.teamfight: Stand where you can stop Jayce Q To the Skies! as he dives onto your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Pin Jayce to a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, but save E to intercept if your damage dealers are at risk. Stick to Jayce and pressure him when his leap is used and he has no mobility left.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce places E Acceleration Gate in Cannon Stance, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so step sideways out of its line. In Hammer Stance, watch for Jayce Q To the Skies! and stop the leap with Poppy W Steadfast Presence; also watch out for the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Karthus.build: Build magic resistance before armor against damage from Karthus Q Lay Waste, Karthus E Defile, and Karthus R Requiem. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces magic resistance, so also get movement speed to avoid the wall and quickly leave Karthus E Defile’s area.
Karthus.combo: Position so Poppy, Karthus, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun him by pushing him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge and follow up with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If you need to interrupt a counterattack, knock him up with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict without charging it.
Karthus.escape: Close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge at that moment, but if you’re going for a stun, first get an angle with a wall behind Karthus.
Karthus.fight: Walk in to close the gap right after dodging Karthus Q Lay Waste, and use Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have an angle to stun him against a wall. Karthus has no spell to create distance, so once you’re close, slow him with Poppy Q Hammer Shock as you trade. If you kill him, leave immediately to avoid the damage from Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.laning: Don’t force an engage on ranged Karthus with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Poke with the extended range of Poppy P Iron Ambassador while securing last-hits. Don’t risk picking up a shield that lands near Karthus.
Karthus.phase: In the mid game, watch out for Karthus’s fast farming. In the late game, use Poppy’s increased durability to protect allied damage dealers instead of focusing on damage.
Karthus.teamfight: Karthus can still deal damage after dying with Karthus P Death Defied, so if you kill him, don’t stay near his corpse; reposition immediately. Don’t stay in range of Karthus E Defile for long while engaging the frontline, and use Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept instead of engage when your allies’ damage dealers are at risk.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals heavy damage if it hits you alone, so walk out after seeing its indicator; if it’s hard to dodge, overlap with minions or an ally. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces magic resistance and slows you when you pass through it, so go around the wall. Karthus R Requiem hits regardless of distance, so keep enough health to survive one after a fight. Even after Karthus is killed, Karthus P Death Defied lets him keep casting spells, so move away from his corpse immediately.

Kayle.build: If the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing is a problem, consider Executioner’s Calling early. Most of Kayle’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance rather than armor. Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces resistances, so avoid it to preserve the value of your added resistance.
Kayle.combo: Position so Poppy, Kayle, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun Kayle by pinning her to the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and an auto attack to land both hits of Poppy Q Hammer Shock. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, knock her up with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict and wait out the invulnerability before attacking again.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge to close in when you have a wall stun angle. Look for an opening after dodging Kayle Q Radiant Blast or when the movement speed boost from Kayle W Celestial Blessing is down. Stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge and deal damage before she can escape with Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Kayle.fight: When Kayle steps up to last-hit, stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge from an angle that uses a wall, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and an auto attack. If there’s no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Kayle.laning: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for wall angles. When Poppy P Iron Ambassador is ready, don’t use it to poke a minion.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a flank or a path from out of vision that lets you reach Kayle directly, and time your engage with your allies’ crowd control. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, lock her down with Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict and wait out the invulnerability. If your allied damage dealers are being targeted, save Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept instead of using it to engage first.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resistance, so avoid being hit directly. When your health is low, watch out for the missing-health damage from Kayle E Starfire Spellblade. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t unload your damage. Lock her down with Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict and wait out the invulnerability.

Kled.build: Build armor first to prepare for Kled’s main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, Kled W Violent Tendencies, and Kled E Jousting. Armor does not mitigate the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and be cautious about stacking health alone given the max-health damage from Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
Kled.combo: Pin Kled to a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and an auto attack. If the dropped shield is on your path to collect it, pick it up for a shield and continue the trade.
Kled.escape: Don’t engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; check whether Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is available too. In particular, before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back, you can close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge and interrupt his counterattack with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, the window to escape is before he pulls you in.
