Kled.fight: When Kled steps forward to last-hit, position so Poppy, Kled, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there’s no wall angle, poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador and save Poppy W Steadfast Presence for Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
Kled.laning: After dismounting Kled, watch his Courage meter. If you can’t finish him, create distance and push him out of lane so he can’t build Courage by killing minions.
Kled.phase: Early on, Poppy lacks poke and engage power, so focus on not giving Kled an advantage. After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, you’ll have more chances to stun him against a wall and intervene in fights. In the mid and late game, Kled’s strength falls off while Poppy becomes more valuable, so protect your allies instead of focusing on damage.
Kled.teamfight: Use flank vision to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! early, and stand in its path so Poppy W Steadfast Presence can stop the charge. If you can’t stop it, keep your formation and use a tank in front to take advantage of the charge hitting the first enemy champion in its path. If Kled reaches your back line, pin him to a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge or knock him away with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Kled.watch: If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, create distance before he pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off briefly to avoid the fourth auto attack’s max-health damage. Save Poppy W Steadfast Presence to respond to engages with Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!

LeeSin.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple deals magic damage, so armor alone won’t mitigate it. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will’s lifesteal restores his health during a long fight, get healing reduction.
LeeSin.combo: Position so Poppy, Lee Sin, and a wall are in a straight line, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and a basic attack. If Lee Sin tries to counterattack, interrupt him with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict without charging it.
LeeSin.escape: When Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or before it comes back, you have an opening to engage. Lee Sin can also escape with W Safeguard / Iron Will, so don’t engage recklessly just because one mobility ability is down. If Lee Sin just used W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage, look for a wall stun angle with Poppy E Heroic Charge and focus your damage.
LeeSin.fight: Look for an opening when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or before it comes back. If Lee Sin steps forward to last-hit near a wall, pin him to it with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. If there’s no angle to pin him to a wall, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and hold Poppy W Steadfast Presence for Lee Sin’s dash.
LeeSin.laning: Early on, don’t take Lee Sin’s strong duels; poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to pin him against the wall beside the lane.
LeeSin.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, look for trades that use walls. In the late game, Lee Sin falls off while Poppy becomes more valuable, so focus on protecting your allies rather than dealing damage.
LeeSin.teamfight: Stand in the path Lee Sin would take into your back line and use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike or the dash from W Safeguard / Iron Will. Then pin him to a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him and protect your allied damage dealers. Keep some distance from your allies so you don’t get hit alongside a target knocked back by Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage.
LeeSin.watch: Stay away from walls without vision, since Lee Sin can cross them with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Account for the physical damage from Malphite W Thunderclap too, since magic resistance cannot block it. Use the max-health damage on Poppy Q Hammer Shock against Malphite’s high armor.
Malphite.combo: Position yourself so Poppy, Malphite, and a wall are in a straight line, then pin him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. When Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately to interrupt his counterattack.
Malphite.escape: If a wall angle opens up here, close the distance and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then interrupt his counterattack with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield before fighting when you can damage his actual health. When he steps forward to last-hit, look for a wall angle and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there is no wall angle or Malphite Q Seismic Shard just hit you, do not force an engage.
Malphite.laning: Break Malphite P Granite Shield and poke at short intervals to keep the shield from regenerating.
Malphite.phase: In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes tankier while falling behind in damage, so focus on protecting your allied carries.
Malphite.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force cannot knock up several of you at once. Poppy W Steadfast Presence cannot stop Malphite R Unstoppable Force, so focus on denying him an engage angle. Counterattack once Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, and use Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept enemies targeting your allied carries.
Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash, so do not try to stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Keep your distance from allies when Malphite is out of sight. Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, so do not start a trade right after it hits.

MasterYi.build: Resistance does not reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, so build health too. Lowering his attack speed slows both his basic attacks and Master Yi Q Alpha Strike’s rotation.
MasterYi.combo: Position yourself so Poppy, Master Yi, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If he is casting Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, wait for him to land before starting.
MasterYi.escape: Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down is your window to close the distance with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to keep him from escaping.
MasterYi.fight: Once Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down, look for a wall angle and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge to start the fight. If he tries to endure it with Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt him with the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge or the knock-up from Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
MasterYi.laning: When Master Yi steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle to pin him against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there is no angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge, poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador, and hold Poppy W Steadfast Presence to counter Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so use opportunities to encounter him and contest early objectives to slow his growth. Poppy is well suited to pressuring melee opponents once she learns Poppy E Heroic Charge and reaches the point where Poppy Q Hammer Shock has a shorter cooldown. In the late game, Master Yi gets stronger while Poppy falls behind in raw damage, so protect your allied carries instead of looking for kills.
MasterYi.teamfight: Stand in the path of Master Yi as he approaches your backline. Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop Master Yi Q Alpha Strike from engaging, then look for an angle to pin him against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge after he lands. Hold Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict’s immobilizing effect for Master Yi W Meditate. Apply crowd control together so an ally does not die alone and give Master Yi a chance to jump to his next target.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi cannot be targeted while casting Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge right after he lands. Slow effects do not work while Master Yi R Highlander is active, and Master Yi E Wuju Style adds true damage to his basic attacks, so be careful not to stay in close combat with him for long.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first to prepare for Wukong’s main damage. Wukong E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, and Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, so do not rely on armor alone for an extended fight. If the healing from Wukong P Stone Skin is a problem, reduce it with Executioner's Calling.
MonkeyKing.combo: Position yourself so Poppy, Wukong, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and a basic attack to hit him with the ground explosion too. If Wukong escapes with Wukong W Warrior Trickster, do not use your combo on the clone; check the real Wukong’s direction.
MonkeyKing.escape: Account for both Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and look for an engage window especially before Wukong W Warrior Trickster is available again. When you have a wall angle, engage and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then follow with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to keep him from escaping.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong builds armor and healing the longer the fight goes on, so trade briefly and disengage. Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence when he engages with Wukong E Nimbus Strike or Wukong W Warrior Trickster, and counterattack with Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have an angle to pin him against a wall.
MonkeyKing.laning: When Wukong steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle by a wall. If there is no angle, poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador and save Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Wukong still has his mobility ability, hold Poppy W Steadfast Presence.
MonkeyKing.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock has a shorter cooldown, look for short trades using walls.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop Wukong as he dashes toward your backline, and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge if a wall angle opens up. Look for objectives or a fight right after Wukong R Cyclone is down.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so it is important to stay out of its range. Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop him as he engages, and watch out for the armor reduction from Wukong Q Crushing Blow that follows. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster creates a clone, do not use abilities on the clone left behind; watch where the real Wukong is heading.

Nasus.build: Build armor first to prepare for Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main source of damage. Nasus E Spirit Fire and R Fury of the Sands deal magic damage, so consider magic resistance too if that damage is a problem. Armor is reduced in the area from E Spirit Fire, so do not stay on it even if you have built resistances.
Nasus.combo: Position yourself so Poppy, Nasus, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there is no wall angle, do not use Poppy E Heroic Charge hoping for a stun.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have a wall angle and Nasus R Fury of the Sands is not active. If Nasus W Wither is down, you can trade without worrying about its slow and attack speed reduction. You do not need to hold Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop a Nasus dash; use it when you need the movement speed.
Nasus.fight: After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to pin Nasus against a wall when he steps forward to last-hit with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. If you stun him, trade with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If there is no angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Do not fight Nasus while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: Pressure Nasus Q Siphoning Strike last-hits from the start to slow its stacks. If you push the wave all the way to Nasus’s turret, he can stack safely, so let the wave come toward you and call for a jungle gank.
Nasus.phase: Nasus is weak early, so after learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, pressure him when he steps forward to last-hit. From the mid game onward, choose when to fight based on Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks and Nasus R Fury of the Sands. In the late game, his stacks make a head-on fight against him unfavorable, so keep your distance and focus on protecting your allies.
Nasus.teamfight: Attack Nasus while keeping your distance instead of taking him head-on while he is still at full health. If he reaches your backline, you can knock him away with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict; account for the direction he will be pushed when charging it for longer. Use Poppy E Heroic Charge at a wall angle where it can protect your allies instead of engaging blindly.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes threatening as it stacks, so keep him from last-hitting freely from the start. Nasus W Wither reduces your movement and attack speed, so do not move alone within his range. Nasus gains defensive stats and power while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, so avoid fighting unless you have a clear advantage.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Nidalee’s damage. If the healing from Nidalee E Primal Surge / Swipe is a problem, reduce it with Executioner's Calling.
Nidalee.combo: Position yourself so Poppy, Nidalee, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun her against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and a basic attack to hit her with the ground explosion too. When Nidalee engages with Pounce, stop her with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If you need to interrupt her counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict without charging it.
Nidalee.escape: Right after you make Nidalee use Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce is your chance to close the distance with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Nidalee has no crowd control, so dodge her spear and trap, then find a wall angle and engage.
Nidalee.fight: Do not forcefully close the distance from far away with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Walk closer immediately after Nidalee misses her spear or uses Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have an angle to pin her against a wall.
Nidalee.laning: Poke and last-hit with the increased range from Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Use the shield if you can safely pick up the fallen buckler; if it lands near Nidalee, do not risk picking it up. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce’s traps around the river and jungle entrances.
Nidalee.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and can use Poppy Q Hammer Shock more often, you will have more chances to fight from a wall angle. In the mid to late game, use your increased durability to stop Nidalee from engaging instead of dealing damage.
Nidalee.teamfight: Stand in front of your backline and use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce’s Pounce. If Nidalee has closed in, pin her against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun her, and if needed, interrupt her counterattack or knock her away with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown’s spear deals more damage the farther it travels, so dodge it with minions between you. Avoid Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce’s trap too, so you can fight without a Hunt mark. If the spear hits you, hold Poppy W Steadfast Presence to counter Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce’s Pounce.

Nocturne.build: Nocturne’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If the healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades is a problem, reduce it with Executioner’s Calling.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, stun him against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then hit him with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the shield first with Poppy Q Hammer Shock, then look for a stun with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Use Poppy E Heroic Charge when you, Nocturne, and the wall are in a straight line.
Nocturne.escape: While Nocturne R Paranoia is down, he has no way to dash in, giving you an opportunity to close the distance with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down, you have less need to save a mobility ability to break its tether.
Nocturne.fight: When Nocturne steps forward to last-hit, look for a wall angle to stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there’s no wall angle, save E and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. If Nocturne R Paranoia is ready, keep Poppy W Steadfast Presence available to use when he dives in.
Nocturne.laning: If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don’t run straight along its trail. Change direction toward an ally or turret. After you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to push Nocturne into the wall beside the lane.
Nocturne.phase: In the mid to late game, Poppy gets tankier but falls behind in damage, so protect your allied carries instead of pushing forward to chase Nocturne.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, group with your allies and guard the route to your backline. Stop Nocturne’s dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge if there’s a wall angle. If Nocturne reaches an ally, choose the direction to knock him away with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Nocturne.watch: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, stay close to your allies and use Poppy W Steadfast Presence when you see Nocturne dash in. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, use Poppy E Heroic Charge to create distance before the fear triggers. Don’t immediately use your key crowd control while Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active.

Nunu.build: Get Executioner's Calling early to reduce healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Build magic resistance first to prepare for Nunu & Willump’s main damage, and get tenacity to account for the crowd control from the snowball.
Nunu.combo: Position yourself so Poppy, Nunu & Willump, and a wall are in a straight line, then stun him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and a basic attack to hit both instances of damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, interrupt the channel with the wall stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge or the instant knock-up from Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
Nunu.escape: Wait for Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! to pass and dodge the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, then look for an angle to engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Nunu & Willump cannot create distance on his own, so catch him with Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have a wall stun angle.
Nunu.fight: When Nunu & Willump steps forward to last-hit, look for a wall angle for Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you cannot stun him against a wall, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have an angle to catch him.
Nunu.laning: Even if you avoid one gank, another may follow right away, so do not stay forward for long. Poppy has limited ability to force a fight early without Poppy E Heroic Charge, so look for trades using walls once you learn it.
Nunu.phase: In the late game, Poppy becomes more valuable as a tank while falling behind in raw damage, so protect your allied carries instead of trying to deal more damage.
Nunu.teamfight: Stand in Nunu & Willump’s path toward your backline and stop him with the wall stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, interrupt the channel with a stun or instant knock-up. If you are out of position to interrupt it, leave the area of Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so watch for snowballs approaching from out of sight. The snowball turns slowly, so instead of running backward, walk toward the incoming snowball and escape through the space Nunu & Willump passed through. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, move out immediately before its delayed root takes effect.

Olaf.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. While Q reduces your armor, the effectiveness of your armor is lower, and armor cannot block the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so build health too. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, lowering his attack speed is also effective.
Olaf.combo: When Olaf R Ragnarok is down, position yourself so Poppy, Olaf, and a wall are in a straight line, then pin him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you can safely pick up the fallen Poppy P Iron Ambassador buckler, continue the trade with its shield.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so after Olaf R Ragnarok ends, engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have a wall angle.
Olaf.fight: When Olaf R Ragnarok is down and you have a wall angle, pin Olaf against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him as he steps forward to last-hit. If there is no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Olaf gains attack speed and lifesteal as his health decreases, so do not engage recklessly just because he is at half health.
Olaf.laning: Poppy has limited ability to force a fight early, and Olaf is strong, so focus on not giving up a kill. Move to the opposite side of where Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands to make it harder for him to retrieve it and approach again. After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to pin Olaf against the wall beside the lane when he steps forward to last-hit.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so avoid forced fights and do not give up a kill. Once Poppy learns E and Q has a shorter cooldown, you will have more chances to trade using wall angles. As time passes, Olaf becomes relatively weaker and Poppy becomes more valuable, so focus on protecting your allies instead of dealing damage in the late game.
Olaf.teamfight: Stand in the path of enemies moving toward your backline and pin them against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge or peel them away with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, do not rely on movement impairment; keep your distance and wait for it to end. Avoid going in deep with E and leaving your allied carries behind.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows you and reduces your armor, so move away from where the axe lands. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge and the movement impairment from Poppy R Keeper's Verdict do not work, so keep your distance. If Olaf’s basic attacks or Olaf E Reckless Swing hit you during this time, R’s duration is extended, and armor cannot reduce the true damage from E.

Ornn.build: The data alone isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage. Build both armor and magic resistance, and avoid relying on a large health stack alone.
Ornn.combo: When there’s a wall behind Ornn, use Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam him into it and stun him, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. While he’s stunned, you can land both hits of Poppy Q Hammer Shock. Don’t use Poppy E Heroic Charge if you don’t have an angle to hit the wall.
Ornn.escape: Don’t go in just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down; check whether Ornn R Call of the Forge God is also available. Look to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge after the Brittle effect from Ornn W Bellows Breath ends and before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up. Then use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Ornn.fight: When Ornn steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle where Poppy, Ornn, and a wall are in a straight line, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge to try to stun him. If there’s no angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and harass with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to respond to Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Ornn.laning: Use Ornn’s low damage early to get ahead, but avoid forcing trades before Poppy learns E Heroic Charge. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, get close and attack to interrupt him. Avoid the area around the pillar created by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture.
Ornn.phase: Ornn’s damage is low early, giving Poppy a chance to get ahead in lane. In the late game, Poppy falls behind in raw damage, so focus on stopping the enemy’s engages. Apply pressure before Ornn’s items and allied Masterwork upgrades stack up.
Ornn.teamfight: Stand in front of your backline and, when you see the dash from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. When an ally damage dealer is being targeted, don’t use Poppy E Heroic Charge to engage first; use it to slam an enemy who has come in into a wall.
Ornn.watch: Near the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and walls, watch for the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, keep your distance until the effect ends. Dodge Ornn R Call of the Forge God by moving out of the straight line between Ornn and the ram spirit.

Pantheon.build: Pantheon’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. However, Pantheon R Grand Starfall has armor penetration, and Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking only health and armor. Pantheon’s high armor also reduces Poppy’s physical damage, so add penetration if you need more damage.
Pantheon.combo: Position so Poppy, Pantheon, and a wall are in a straight line, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam Pantheon into the wall. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front, wait for it to end or attack from the side.
Pantheon.escape: Pantheon W Shield Vault and Pantheon R Grand Starfall are both ways for him to move, so don’t go in just because one is down. Look to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge when Pantheon W Shield Vault is also down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. Follow with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to stop him from escaping.
Pantheon.fight: If Pantheon W Shield Vault is available, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If there’s no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and harass only with your passive shield. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait before attacking him from the front or reposition to the side.
Pantheon.laning: Early on, keep minions between you and Pantheon to reduce Pantheon Q Comet Spear damage, and focus on not giving up a kill. After Poppy learns E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to push Pantheon into the wall beside the lane when he steps up to last-hit. Don’t overextend to collect your shield if it falls toward Pantheon.
Pantheon.phase: Once Poppy learns E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, look to trade when you have a wall angle. In the late game, Pantheon’s influence falls off and Poppy becomes more valuable, so protect your allies’ damage dealers instead of focusing on dealing damage.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stand in the path Pantheon would take to reach your backline and use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop Pantheon W Shield Vault. Then use Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam him into a wall and stun him. If you need to interrupt a close counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, move out of its landing area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so stay out of its range. Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop his dash as he jumps in. Take Pantheon Q Comet Spear from behind minions. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Quinn.build: Buy an armor item first. Quinn P Harrier, Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and Quinn E Vault all deal physical damage, so armor is the resistance you need against her.
Quinn.combo: Position so Poppy, Quinn, and a wall are in a straight line, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge to push Quinn into the wall and stun her. If you need to interrupt Quinn’s counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately without charging it.
Quinn.escape: The window to engage opens right after Quinn E Vault is down. She has no escape during that time, so close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge and, if needed, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to keep her from getting away.
Quinn.fight: Don’t force an engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge while Quinn E Vault is available. Stop Quinn E Vault with Poppy W Steadfast Presence or close the gap right after she uses it. Fight when you have an angle to push her into a wall.
Quinn.laning: Early on, respect Quinn’s range and preserve your health while farming. Harass with the extended range of Poppy P Iron Ambassador, and use a shield you can pick up to gain a shield. Right after Quinn misses a poke ability, walk closer, but save Poppy E Heroic Charge for an opportunity.
Quinn.phase: In the early laning phase, Poppy needs to preserve her health and hold on against Quinn’s range advantage. In the mid and late game, once items have stacked, Poppy becomes more valuable, so focus on stopping enemy damage dealers in teamfights instead of dealing damage.
Quinn.teamfight: Start teamfights instead of facing Quinn alone in a side lane. If Quinn comes in from the flank, use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop Quinn E Vault. If you have an angle, use Poppy E Heroic Charge to push her into a wall and stun her. When your backline is being targeted, don’t use Poppy E Heroic Charge to engage first; use it to protect your allies.
Quinn.watch: When marked by Quinn P Harrier, move outside her basic attack range to avoid the empowered attack. Take Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind a line of minions. When Quinn comes in with Quinn E Vault, use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop her dash.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first to handle Rammus’s main damage from Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and Rammus R Soaring Slam. Consider tenacity if you often die while locked down by crowd control.
Rammus.combo: Position so Poppy, Rammus, and a wall are in a straight line, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam him into the wall. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, stop basic attacking and concentrate your damage when its duration ends.
Rammus.escape: The window when Rammus R Soaring Slam is down is your chance to engage, so find a wall angle and go in with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Look for an angle from outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range, and if you’re taunted, account for moving only after it ends.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, stop trading basic attacks and concentrate your damage immediately after it ends. Watch for the dash from Rammus R Soaring Slam and stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If there’s no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and harass with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Rammus.laning: Early on, avoid forcing trades because Poppy Q Hammer Shock has a long cooldown and Poppy doesn’t have E Heroic Charge yet. Look to use Poppy E Heroic Charge from an angle with a wall when Rammus steps up to last-hit. Place minions in the path of an approaching Rammus Q Powerball, and save Poppy W Steadfast Presence while Rammus R Soaring Slam is available.
Rammus.phase: Early on, Poppy has little ability to force a fight before learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, so focus on poking. Later, use Poppy’s value and ability to protect allies to keep your damage dealers safe instead of focusing on damage.
Rammus.teamfight: Stand in the path of Rammus R Soaring Slam as he moves toward your backline so you can stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. After Rammus comes in, use Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam him into a wall and separate him from your damage dealers. If Rammus Q Powerball has built up speed, allow for a wider Rammus R Soaring Slam landing area and move with your allies out of the landing point.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, get minions between you and him to block the collision. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is targeted, so stay out of its range. Rammus R Soaring Slam covers a larger area after Rammus Q Powerball builds speed, so move well clear and leave the landing point immediately.

RekSai.build: Build armor first to withstand Rek’Sai’s main damage. The true damage from Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel can’t be reduced with resistances, and Rek’Sai R Void Rush scales with your max health, so avoid relying on a large health stack alone. If the healing from Rek’Sai P Fury of the Xer’Sai is a problem, buy Executioner’s Calling to reduce it.
RekSai.combo: Position so Poppy, Rek’Sai, and a wall are in a straight line, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam her into the wall and stun her. If there’s no wall angle, don’t use Poppy E Heroic Charge first.
RekSai.escape: After dodging the knock-up from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, you have a chance to fight without her reliable crowd control. If only Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek’Sai R Void Rush, so look for a window when Rek’Sai R Void Rush is also down. Then close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge and use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to stop her from escaping.
RekSai.fight: When Rek’Sai steps forward to last-hit, start a damage trade with Poppy E Heroic Charge if you have an angle to push her into a wall. If there’s no angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and harass with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Use the saved Poppy W Steadfast Presence to respond to Rek’Sai’s engage.
RekSai.laning: Don’t push the lane too hard early, and don’t move alone where you lack vision. If you see an entrance to a tunnel made by Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel near the lane or in your own jungle, walk over it to destroy it. After Poppy learns E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to push Rek’Sai into the wall beside the lane.
RekSai.phase: Early on, watch out for Rek’Sai trying to get ahead through ganks, and play to avoid giving up a kill. Poppy can focus on close-range trades after learning Poppy E Heroic Charge and getting a shorter cooldown on Poppy Q Hammer Shock. In the mid and late game, Poppy becomes more valuable but falls behind in damage, so focus on stopping enemy engages.
RekSai.teamfight: Stand in the path Rek’Sai would take to reach your backline and use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop her dash. Then, if you have a wall angle, use Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun Rek’Sai and protect your allies. Use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately to interrupt a counterattack in a duel, and charge it to knock an enemy far away.
RekSai.watch: When Rek’Sai goes underground with Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, watch for the moment she knocks you up with Un-burrow, and move toward open ground away from walls and narrow paths. Save Poppy W Steadfast Presence to prepare for engages with Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and Rek’Sai R Void Rush. Immediately after Rek’Sai hits you, you may become the target of Rek’Sai R Void Rush, so move close to your allies.

Renekton.build: Renekton’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek is a problem, buy Executioner’s Calling to reduce it. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Renekton R Dominus.
Renekton.combo: Position so Poppy, Renekton, and a wall are in a straight line, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam him into the wall. Locking him down with E makes it easier to land the explosive damage from Q’s area.
Renekton.escape: Go in when Renekton E Slice and Dice and the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator are both down.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no rage, and avoid the stun range of Renekton W Ruthless Predator when his rage is full. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is available, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence and press it when you see the dash. Counterattack after Renekton has used Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice.
Renekton.laning: Don’t stand in or behind a minion wave where Renekton E Slice and Dice can use the minions as a stepping stone to engage. When Renekton steps up to last-hit and build rage, look for a wall angle and try to stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there’s no angle, save E and harass with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Renekton.phase: Avoid fights while Renekton R Dominus is active, don’t give up a kill, and keep developing. From the mid game onward, when Renekton’s value falls and Poppy becomes more valuable, focus on protecting your allies instead of dealing damage.
Renekton.teamfight: Stop Renekton E Slice and Dice as he moves toward your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Then, if you have a wall angle, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you need to interrupt a counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately without charging it. If the enemy is targeting your damage dealers, don’t use E to engage first.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton’s rage from Renekton P Reign of Anger is near or above half, watch out for the empowered stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of range. Empowered W breaks shields first, so don’t try to block the combo with the shield from Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Watch for the dash from Renekton E Slice and Dice and stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence.

Rengar.build: Rengar’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If healing from Rengar W Battle Roar is a problem, buy Executioner’s Calling to reduce it, then build into an upgraded item if you’re going for defensive items.
Rengar.combo: When Rengar W Battle Roar is down and his resource bar is empty, use Poppy E Heroic Charge from a wall angle to stun him, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If you need to interrupt a counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately without charging it.
Rengar.escape: Go in after Rengar E Bola Strike has been avoided, Rengar W Battle Roar is down, and his resource bar is empty. Rengar has no ability to create distance himself, so if you have a wall angle, lock him down with Poppy E Heroic Charge and follow with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar’s resource bar is empty and right after Rengar W Battle Roar is down. If he leaps in with Rengar P Unseen Predator, stop him with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge from a position where you can push him into a wall.
Rengar.laning: Early on, avoid paths beside brush and use a Control Ward to get vision of it. When Rengar steps forward to last-hit, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge from an angle where Poppy, Rengar, and a wall are in a straight line. If there’s no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and harass with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Rengar.phase: After Poppy learns E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, look for close-range trades when you have a wall angle. In the mid and late game, Poppy becomes more valuable but falls behind in raw damage, so focus on stopping Rengar’s engages.
Rengar.teamfight: Stand in front of your backline and within vision so you can stop Rengar’s leap with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. After Rengar W Battle Roar is down, use Poppy E Heroic Charge to push him into a wall and stun him, then attack with your allies. When you need to protect your backline, don’t use Poppy E Heroic Charge to engage far away first.
Rengar.watch: Near brush, watch out for the leap from Rengar P Unseen Predator. If Rengar isn’t visible, avoid paths beside brush. When Rengar’s resource bar is full, watch out for the root from Rengar E Bola Strike and the crowd control cleanse from Rengar W Battle Roar, and delay trading. When Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active, don’t travel alone while injured; stay with your allies.

Riven.build: All of Riven’s damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, prioritize defensive items sooner, and get enough health to avoid being finished off by Riven R Blade of the Exile while low.
Riven.combo: Position so Poppy, Riven, and a wall are in a straight line, then use Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam her into it and stun her. If Riven gets close and starts her combo, interrupt her counterattack with Poppy E Heroic Charge or an immediate Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Riven.escape: Go in after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings on minions or spends it to dash, before she can use it again. If Riven E Valor is still available, she can escape, so check whether she has used it too. When an opportunity opens, close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Riven.fight: The moment after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions is your chance to counterattack. While Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are available, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If you have no angle to slam her into a wall, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and harass with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Riven.laning: Afterward, when Riven steps forward to last-hit, use the wall to your side to find a stun angle with Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Riven.phase: In the mid and late game, use Poppy’s growing durability to focus on stopping Riven’s engages.
Riven.teamfight: Wait for Riven as she comes toward your backline, then use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop the dash from Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor. Follow with Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam her into a wall and stun her. If Riven gets close and counterattacks, interrupt her with an immediate Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are dashes that can close the gap in succession. When you see the first dash, move back and use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop the next one. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase. The lower your health, the more dangerous Wind Slash becomes, so keep your distance until the effect ends.

Rumble.build: Prioritize a defensive item with magic resist. Most of Rumble’s damage is magic, and Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: Line up Poppy, Rumble, and the wall, then stun him against it with Poppy E Heroic Charge and follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If you need to interrupt Rumble’s counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately without charging it.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility spell, so the window after Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield is gone and its movement speed boost has ended is a good time to engage. If you’re hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, don’t stand your ground; when you have a favorable wall angle, use Poppy E Heroic Charge before the second shot arrives. If not, use the movement speed from Poppy W Steadfast Presence to create distance.
Rumble.fight: When Rumble steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle to push him into the wall beside the lane. If he activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, save your burst until the shield disappears, then wait for the movement speed boost to wear off before catching him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If there’s no wall angle, don’t force an engage; poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Rumble.laning: Keep enough distance that Rumble has to walk forward to trade, and don’t use Poppy P Iron Ambassador on minions. After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for moments when there’s a wall behind him.
Rumble.phase: Look for wall stuns once you’ve learned Poppy E Heroic Charge and can use Poppy Q Hammer Shock more often. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but falls behind in damage, so focus on protecting your allies.
Rumble.teamfight: Stand in front of your backline and hold the path Rumble would take as he approaches, avoiding prolonged exposure to Rumble Q Flamespitter. Poppy W Steadfast Presence has no dash from Rumble to block, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have a wall angle to push him away. If you need to split up a teamfight, charge and cast Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict from out of vision.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your max health while he is close, so create distance to avoid taking it for long. If you’re hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, get out of range before the second shot. Consecutive hits increase the slow and reduce your magic resist.

Sejuani.build: Prioritize magic resist against the magic damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Q Arctic Assault, and E Permafrost. Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath deals physical damage, so magic resist won’t block it. Stacking health alone also increases the damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, which scales with your max health.
Sejuani.combo: Line up Poppy, Sejuani, and the wall, then stun her against it with Poppy E Heroic Charge and follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock, then basic attacks. While she’s stunned, she can also take the area explosion from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, so if you have a wall angle, use Poppy E Heroic Charge before Poppy Q Hammer Shock. If you need to interrupt her counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict immediately without charging it.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after you make Sejuani use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is a window to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you engage from a wall angle, follow with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict to keep Sejuani from escaping. If you’re stunned by Sejuani E Permafrost, create distance as soon as it ends to avoid the follow-up basic attack that deals damage based on your max health.
Sejuani.fight: Save Poppy W Steadfast Presence while Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is available, and use it when you see her dash. Once that dash is down, find a wall angle to stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge and follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If there’s no wall angle, don’t force Poppy E Heroic Charge; poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Sejuani.laning: When Sejuani steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle to use the wall beside the lane with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Sejuani P Fury of the North has activated her Frost Armor, deal damage first to create an opening for the armor to break. If the shield lands on the enemy’s side, don’t overextend to pick it up.
Sejuani.phase: In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes tankier but falls behind in raw damage, so focus on stopping Sejuani’s engage and protecting your allies.
Sejuani.teamfight: Stand in the path Sejuani Q Arctic Assault would take toward your backline so you can stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. After Sejuani engages, stun her against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge and protect your allied damage dealers. If you need to peel multiple enemies away, charge and cast Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, planning their knockback direction in advance.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault knocks you up as she dashes in, so use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to block it when you see her engage. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, leave range before the second strike, which deals heavy damage and applies a strong slow. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks from melee allies’ basic attacks too, so create distance as its indicator builds up. Dodge Sejuani R Glacial Prison by moving sideways.

Sett.build: Prioritize armor against the basic attack damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Attack speed reduction is also useful. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your max health, and resistance can’t reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so focus on avoiding the center instead of stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: Line up Poppy, Sett, and the wall, then stun Sett against it with Poppy E Heroic Charge. After dealing damage, sidestep Sett W Haymaker’s center aiming line.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, look for a wall angle with Poppy E Heroic Charge without worrying about the stun. If Sett R The Show Stopper is still available, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence to react to it.
Sett.fight: When Sett R The Show Stopper is down, engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge from an angle that uses a wall. If Sett engages with Sett R The Show Stopper, block it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, which you’ve saved for that moment.
Sett.phase: After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge and when Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown is shorter, pressure Sett using walls. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but falls behind in raw damage, so focus on protecting your allied damage dealers.
Sett.teamfight: Hold the path Sett would take toward your backline so you can block Sett R The Show Stopper with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If Sett approaches, stun him against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and interrupt his counterattack with an immediately cast, uncharged Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict if needed. Don’t stand on top of your allies, so Sett can’t throw you into them with Sett R The Show Stopper.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker becomes dangerous immediately after Sett has taken a lot of damage, so create distance briefly after dealing heavy damage. If it’s hard to dodge, step to the side of the aiming line to avoid the center’s true damage. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when there are enemies on both sides of Sett, so don’t stand between him and a group of minions.
Sett.laning: If you don’t have an angle to push him into a wall, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Stay away from the space between Sett and a group of minions to avoid the stun from Sett E Facebreaker.

Shaco.build: Prioritize magic resist against the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, E Two-Shiv Poison, and R Hallucinate. Build some health to avoid the low-health threshold where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage, and get movement speed to leave areas where danger is telegraphed.
Shaco.combo: From an angle that lines up Poppy, Shaco, and the wall, stun him against it with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. He can take both hits from Poppy Q Hammer Shock while stunned, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge first if you have a wall stun angle.
Shaco.escape: The moment after you make Shaco use Shaco Q Deceive is an opportunity to approach with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Check areas where you lack vision and suspect Shaco W Jack In The Box before entering, and respond to Shaco Q Deceive’s engage with Poppy W Steadfast Presence.
Shaco.fight: Save Poppy W Steadfast Presence while Shaco Q Deceive is available, and use it as Shaco engages. Just after Shaco Q Deceive is down, close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge, positioning for a stun against the wall behind him.
Shaco.laning: When Shaco steps forward to last-hit, look for a stun with Poppy E Heroic Charge if you have a wall angle. If not, save Poppy E Heroic Charge, poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador, and hold Poppy W Steadfast Presence to respond to Shaco Q Deceive.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco looks to gain an advantage through ganks and invades, so maintain vision at your jungle entrances and don’t give him a kill. Poppy can push close-range fights once she has learned Poppy E Heroic Charge and can use Poppy Q Hammer Shock more often. In the late game, Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off while Poppy becomes more valuable, so focus on protecting your allies instead of dealing damage.
Shaco.teamfight: Respond to Shaco Q Deceive as he enters your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then focus him with your allies as soon as he appears. Use Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept Shaco and stun him against a wall, rather than engaging ahead and away from your allies. When Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone dies, move away to avoid the explosion and fear.
Shaco.watch: If Shaco gets behind you with Shaco Q Deceive, his empowered attack is hard to avoid, so face your allies or stand with a wall at your back if you think he’s nearby. Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes you have no vision of and around objectives causes fear, so check with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens before approaching. When your health is low, avoid paths where you have no vision because of Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.

Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus on just one type of resistance. Avoid stacking health alone because of the damage that scales with your max health.
Shen.combo: Line up Poppy, Shen, and the wall, then stun him against it with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, wait until it ends before using basic attacks.
Shen.escape: Engage just after Shen E Shadow Dash misses and its taunt and mobility are down. It’s an even better opportunity if Shen R Stand United is also unavailable, but use Poppy E Heroic Charge only after finding an angle to stun him against a wall.
Shen.fight: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to counterattack. From an angle with a wall behind Shen, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge and follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If there’s no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Shen.laning: Early on, look for a wall angle when Shen steps forward to last-hit. Save Poppy W Steadfast Presence to react to Shen E Shadow Dash. Push the lane to keep Shen occupied with CS, and take advantage there if Shen leaves the lane with Shen R Stand United.
Shen.phase: Once you’ve learned Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown is shorter, you can push close-range trades.
Shen.teamfight: Shen can join fights with Shen R Stand United, so alert your team immediately if he leaves the lane or begins channeling. In fights, block Shen E Shadow Dash as he heads for your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge if you get a wall angle. Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict can be used immediately to interrupt an enemy counterattack, or charged to knock enemies far away.
Shen.watch: If you’re taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’ll take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault. Block Shen’s dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and also move out of the path of his Spirit Blade as it returns to him.

Shyvana.build: Consider Executioner’s Calling first to reduce healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis. Prioritize magic resist against the damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon’s Descent, and build armor against her basic attack damage.
Shyvana.combo: Line up Poppy, Shyvana, and the wall, then stun her against it with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Don’t try this combo while she’s flying in with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent; use it after she lands.
Shyvana.escape: Once Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is down, look for an opportunity to engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Shyvana.fight: When Shyvana steps forward to last-hit, use Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun her against a wall and take a short trade if you have an angle. If not, save Poppy E Heroic Charge, poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador, and keep your distance. Look for another chance to catch her when Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is down or after her transformation ends.
Shyvana.laning: After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to push Shyvana into the wall beside the lane when she steps forward to last-hit. Pressure her early, before Shyvana P Scalemail stacks build up.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana becomes harder to deal with over time because of her permanent stacks, so focus on stopping her engage in the late game instead of dealing damage.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren’t caught in the path of Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent or her area-of-effect abilities. Wait near your backline for Shyvana to land, then either stun her against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge or interrupt her counterattack with Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Counterattack when Shyvana returns to human form and loses her bonus health and empowered abilities.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying in with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, so don’t try to stop her engage with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. After she lands, watch out for the empowered basic attack from Shyvana Q Emberstrike and the damage based on your max health from Shyvana E Molten Burst. Don’t stay close to her for long while Shyvana W Inferno Aegis is active.

Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so avoid Singed W Mega Adhesive and look to engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge once Singed E Fling is down.

Sion.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion W Soul Furnace and E Roar of the Slayer deal magic damage, so armor won’t block them. Avoid Sion E Roar of the Slayer first, since it reduces your armor, and don’t stack health alone because of the damage from Sion P Glory in Death.
Sion.combo: Line up Poppy, Sion, and the wall, then stun him against it with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Use Poppy Q Hammer Shock on the stunned Sion and follow with a basic attack to land both hits from its area. If Poppy P Iron Ambassador’s shield lands somewhere you can retrieve it, move forward to collect it and gain a shield.
Sion.escape: Make Sion use Sion Q Decimating Smash early, then look to trade once its knock-up and stun are down. If Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is available, don’t use Poppy W Steadfast Presence early; save it for his charge.
Sion.fight: When Sion steps forward to last-hit and you have an angle to push him into the wall behind him, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then trade with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If there’s no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Right after Sion W Soul Furnace activates, focus damage to break the shield before it bursts.
Sion.laning: After that, when Sion steps forward to last-hit, use the wall beside the lane to find a stun angle for Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Sion keeps farming, his max health increases permanently, so push the lane to disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane during that time.
Sion.phase: In the late game, Poppy gets tankier but contributes less damage, while Sion keeps gaining max health from killing units, so don’t leave him alone and let the game drag on.
Sion.teamfight: Stand in the path of Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught as he heads for your backline and block his charge with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Then, if you have a wall angle, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you need to interrupt a counterattack immediately, use Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict without charging it. When your allied damage dealers are being targeted, intercept Sion from beside them instead of engaging first.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash becomes more dangerous the longer he charges it, as it can knock you up and stun you, so step aside when you see him charging. Don’t face Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge to the side, and block his engage with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Even after you take Sion down, he revives with Sion P Glory in Death, so don’t keep fighting in the same spot; reposition.

Skarner.build: First decide whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter Skarner R Impale’s suppression. Since Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale deal magic damage, build magic resistance first. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your max health, so be cautious about relying on a large health boost alone.
Skarner.combo: Position yourself so Poppy, Skarner, and a wall are in a line, then slam him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, you can use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to further reduce his time to escape.
Skarner.escape: Right after you make Skarner use E Ixtal's Impact is your window to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Skarner R Impale is available, be careful not to go so deep that he can suppress you.
Skarner.fight: While Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, hold Poppy W Steadfast Presence and use it when you see the dash. Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, look for a chance to close the gap. When you have a wall angle, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then trade with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks.
Skarner.laning: When Skarner steps up to last-hit, look for an angle to push him toward a wall, but save Poppy E Heroic Charge if you don’t have a stun angle. Instead, poke with the extra range from Poppy P Iron Ambassador, and don’t force yourself to retrieve the shield if it lands near Skarner.
Skarner.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, look for close trades when you have a wall angle. Skarner’s damage and durability both increase as he builds tank items, so it’s important not to give up early objective control.
Skarner.teamfight: Stop Skarner E Ixtal's Impact when he dashes toward your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge when you have a wall angle. If your allied carries are in danger, use Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept instead of diving far ahead. Skarner R Impale can’t be interrupted by a stun, so keep in mind where your allies could be pulled and the terrain around the edges of the Dragon and Baron pits.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, and stuns you if it grabs you and slams you into a wall. Don’t stand with your back to a wall; stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence as it comes in. Skarner R Impale’s suppression can’t be interrupted by a stun, so be especially careful when entering its short range.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Taliyah’s main damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Also use the magic resistance from Poppy W Steadfast Presence during fights.
Taliyah.combo: Line up Poppy, Taliyah, and a wall, then slam her into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun her. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and a basic attack to hit her with Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s ground eruption while she’s stunned.
Taliyah.escape: Don’t engage as soon as only one of Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is down; check her remaining mobility options and the rock field first. In particular, before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back off cooldown, dodge Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, then look for an angle to close in with Poppy E Heroic Charge. When Taliyah dashes in, stop her with Poppy W Steadfast Presence.
Taliyah.fight: Walk in to close the gap right after Taliyah uses a poke ability, and save Poppy E Heroic Charge until you have a wall angle. If you pass through Taliyah E Unraveled Earth with Poppy E Heroic Charge, you’ll be stunned, so approach on foot or go around it.
Taliyah.laning: Safely pick up your dropped shield for the shield, but don’t force yourself to retrieve it if it rolls toward Taliyah. If Taliyah disappears from sight, watch for her to intervene in another lane.
Taliyah.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, look for a wall stun. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but her raw damage falls behind, so protect your allies instead of chasing Taliyah to deal damage.
Taliyah.teamfight: Guard Taliyah’s approach near your backline, and stop her with Poppy W Steadfast Presence when she dashes in. If a wall angle opens up, stun her with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and interrupt nearby enemies’ retaliation with an uncharged Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can’t change its cast direction, so dodge to the side instead of approaching in a straight line.

Teemo.build: Since Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap deal his main magic damage, build magic resistance first. Get Oracle Lens ready to clear traps along key routes.
Teemo.combo: Line up Poppy, Teemo, and a wall, then push him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock to hit him twice, and use basic attacks when Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down or the blind has ended. If you need to interrupt his retaliation during the duel, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately without charging it.
Teemo.escape: The window to engage is right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Teemo has no escape besides Teemo W Move Quick, so save Poppy E Heroic Charge to close the gap. If you don’t have a wall stun angle, account for Poppy E Heroic Charge only knocking him back without a stun.
Teemo.fight: Look for a damage trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Before then, poke and last-hit with the extra range from Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Right after Teemo uses a poke ability, walk in to close the gap and look for an angle to use Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you commit, stay on him so you don’t take only poison damage and then back away.
Teemo.laning: Early on, don’t force an engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge; poke and last-hit with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. If you can safely pick up your dropped shield, use the shield to stay in lane longer, but don’t force yourself to pick it up if it lands near Teemo. Check brush without vision with a Control Ward or go around it, then wait for Teemo to show himself and counterattack.
Teemo.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and can use Poppy Q Hammer Shock more often, look for a wall stun. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes tankier while her raw damage falls behind, so protect your allied carries and push the lane with your allied jungler to pressure Teemo before he has time to plant mushrooms.
Teemo.teamfight: Protect your backline and use Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept enemies approaching your allied carries. Clear Teemo R Noxious Trap along key routes with Oracle Lens, and assume there are traps in front of objectives and in narrow passages as you move. When charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to knock enemies away, first consider the direction they’ll be pushed.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so stop auto-attacking while blinded and use abilities or back away. Even one basic attack from Teemo E Toxic Shot applies lingering poison damage, so stay out of range if you aren’t ready to close in. Also watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in brush without vision and Teemo R Noxious Trap along key routes.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Thornmail is effective against an opponent who relies on basic attacks. If the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust is a problem, reduce it with Executioner's Calling.
Tryndamere.combo: Line up Poppy, Tryndamere, and a wall, then slam him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t pour in more damage with a combo; buy time or knock him away with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere uses Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is your window to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Avoid trading basic attacks immediately after being hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.fight: When Tryndamere steps up to last-hit, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge from an angle near a wall, then trade. If you don’t have a wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Keep Poppy W Steadfast Presence available while Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is up.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, poke Tryndamere to stop him from last-hitting and limit his Fury and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. If he starts building Fury by hitting minions, create distance before engaging. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash can come back quickly around a large minion wave, so don’t fight there for long.
Tryndamere.phase: In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but her raw damage falls behind, so focus on stopping the enemy’s engage instead of dealing damage in duels.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Stop Tryndamere E Spinning Slash when he enters your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then slam him into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to protect your allies. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, you can knock him away with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to buy time. If Tryndamere’s ultimate is available in a side lane, don’t try to stop him alone; bring more allies or trade for an objective.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere uses Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to engage, stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop dealing damage and buy time or create distance with Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. When backing away to avoid Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, walk backward while facing him.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals a mix of physical and magic damage, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone can’t block all of it. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle is a problem, reduce it with Executioner's Calling.
Udyr.combo: When Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened effect ends and you have a wall angle, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then attack with Poppy Q Hammer Shock followed by a basic attack. If you need to interrupt his retaliation, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately without charging it.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use E Blazing Stampede is your chance to engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you’ve already been stunned once by Udyr E Blazing Stampede, he can’t stun the same target again for a while, so counterattack or get away during that time. If he’s Awakened, immobilizing effects won’t work, so catch him with Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict after the effect ends.
Udyr.fight: While Udyr E Blazing Stampede is available, hold Poppy W Steadfast Presence to counter his engage. Right after Udyr uses E Blazing Stampede, find a wall angle and push him into it with Poppy E Heroic Charge; go on the offensive once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so ward key routes and jungle entrances, and don’t move forward when he’s out of sight. When countering a gank, respond to Udyr E Blazing Stampede with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and save Poppy E Heroic Charge if you don’t have an angle to slam him into a wall.
Udyr.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, you can push into close fights. In the mid to late game, Poppy gets tankier but her raw damage falls behind, so protect your allied carries instead of hitting Udyr for a long time.
Udyr.teamfight: Stop Udyr E Blazing Stampede as he enters your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, and push him into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge after the Awakened effect ends. Don’t force yourself to kill Udyr through his defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield; deal with the weaker allies in the back first, then finish him off with a numbers advantage.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes the gap and stuns, so stop the dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence when you see it coming. While Udyr E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, immobilizing effects don’t work, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict after the Awakened effect ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your max health.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Since Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your max health, don’t rely on a large health boost alone; also consider your total health when trying to stay above the execution threshold from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. Poppy’s physical damage can be mitigated by Urgot’s high armor, so consider penetration if you need more damage.
Urgot.combo: When Urgot E Disdain is down and Poppy, Urgot, and a wall are in a line, slam him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and a basic attack to hit both instances of Q’s damage. If you need to interrupt his retaliation, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict immediately without charging it.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility tool, so right after you block it or force him to use it is your opportunity to engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge. You can also walk in to close the gap right after Urgot Q Corrosive Charge misses. Conversely, if you need to get away after being hit by Q, use Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Urgot.fight: Stop Urgot E Disdain with Poppy W Steadfast Presence or close the gap right after he uses E. Don’t stay on him long enough to take repeated leg-cannon damage; make a short trade when you have a wall angle, then get out of range.
Urgot.laning: Early on, poke and last-hit with the extra range from Poppy P Iron Ambassador. Pick up your dropped shield for the shield, but don’t force yourself to retrieve it if it lands near Urgot. Right after Urgot’s poke ability misses, walk in to close the gap, and save Poppy E Heroic Charge for a wall angle.
Urgot.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s cooldown gets shorter, look for a wall angle when Urgot E Disdain is down. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but her raw damage falls behind, so focus on protecting your allies in teamfights.
Urgot.teamfight: Stand along the path of Urgot E Disdain as he enters your backline, and stop his dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Then stun him against a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge, and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to push him away if needed. Don’t stay on Urgot and take repeated leg-cannon damage.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your max health, so don’t stay close to him for long. Stop his dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence when Urgot E Disdain comes in, and dodge Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, which leads into a heavy slow and focused fire. If you’re hit by Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, get completely out of range before you reach the execution threshold.

Vi.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, Vi W Denting Blows, and Vi E Relentless Force, her main sources of damage. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health. Attack speed reduction also helps limit Vi's basic attack combos.
Vi.combo: When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down and there's a wall behind her, slam her into it with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun her, then follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. While she's stunned, you can also hit the ground explosion from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, so use Poppy E Heroic Charge first if you have a wall angle. If Vi R Cease and Desist is carrying her toward you, save forced movement and interrupt her counterattack with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict after she lands.
Vi.escape: Vi Q Vault Breaker is her only mobility tool, so the moment after you force her to use it is your window to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you have a wall angle, stun her, then use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to limit her chance to escape. If Vi R Cease and Desist is in progress, don't use forced movement; wait until she lands.
Vi.fight: Trade briefly after Vi P Blast Shield has been removed, then create distance before Vi W Denting Blows stacks up. The moment after you dodge Vi Q Vault Breaker or stop it with Poppy W Steadfast Presence is your chance to engage. If there's a wall behind her, look for a stun with Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Vi.laning: When Vi steps up to last-hit, look for an angle that puts a wall behind her. If there isn't one, poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador and save Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Vi triggers Vi P Blast Shield by using an ability on a minion, trade after the shield has been removed.
Vi.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock's cooldown is shorter, look for a wall stun while Vi Q Vault Breaker is down.
Vi.teamfight: Stand in the path of Vi Q Vault Breaker as she dashes toward your backline and stop her with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Vi R Cease and Desist follows its target to the end, so keep your allied damage dealers within your protection range. After Vi lands and the knock-up ends, peel her off with Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. When an allied damage dealer is being targeted, don't use Poppy E Heroic Charge to engage first.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage when fully charged, so dodge backward or to the side when you see her charging. Use Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop her as she dashes in. While Vi R Cease and Desist is carrying her toward you, don't use forced movement; respond after she lands and the knock-up ends.

Viego.build: Build armor first to reduce the main damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. Armor won't reduce the magic damage from Viego W Spectral Maw. If a prolonged duel makes the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King a problem, get resistances, then reduce his healing with Executioner's Calling.
Viego.combo: Position yourself, Viego, and a wall in a straight line, then slam him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him.
Viego.escape: Don't go in just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down; check whether he can still use Viego R Heartbreaker. Look especially for a window before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, closing the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge and following with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. If you see Viego charging Viego W Spectral Maw, dodge to the side first or interrupt it with Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
Viego.fight: When Viego steps forward to last-hit, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge from a wall angle and trade. If there isn't a wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. If Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker is available, time Poppy W Steadfast Presence to meet his engage.
Viego.laning: After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to push Viego into the wall beside the lane when he steps up to last-hit. Don't push the lane toward visible black mist; avoid that path or use a Control Ward.
Viego.phase: In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but focus on stopping Viego's engages and preventing kills to limit his growth instead of focusing on damage.
Viego.teamfight: Stand in Viego's path as he moves toward your backline and respond to engages with Viego W Spectral Maw or Viego R Heartbreaker using Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Follow with Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam Viego into a wall and protect your allied damage dealers. If an ally has been taken down, push Viego away or hold him back so he can't reach the possession site, and don't keep fighting near it.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw's stun lasts longer the more he charges it, so dodge to the side when you see him charging and interrupt it with Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Viego R Heartbreaker targets champions with a low percentage of remaining health, so back away when your health is low. If you see black mist over terrain, Viego may be camouflaged, so avoid that path.

Volibear.build: Build armor first to reduce the main damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and Volibear R Stormbringer. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a problem, reduce it with Executioner's Calling.
