Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about choices that only add a lot of health.
Volibear.combo: Position yourself, Volibear, and a wall in a straight line, then slam him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks to hit the ground explosion from Poppy Q Hammer Shock while he's stunned. If you need to interrupt Volibear's counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict without charging it.
Volibear.escape: Engage after both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and Volibear R Stormbringer are down. If only one is down, wait because he can escape with the other, especially looking for a window before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back. Then close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge and prevent his escape with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict.
Volibear.fight: When Volibear engages with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer, stop his dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If you get a wall angle as he steps forward to last-hit, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge and trade briefly. Volibear can heal with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, so don't prolong a fight you can't finish.
Volibear.laning: If you don't have a wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. If Volibear has stacked Volibear P The Relentless Storm by hitting minions, avoid fighting and look for an opening after the stacks wear off.
Volibear.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock's cooldown is shorter, look for close trades using wall angles. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable, but loses out in raw damage, so focus on protecting allies instead of attacking Volibear for a long time.
Volibear.teamfight: Stand in Volibear's path toward your backline and stop his dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence when he engages with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer. Follow with Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam him into a wall and stun him, and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to peel him off if needed. If Volibear has stacked Volibear P The Relentless Storm, avoid the fight and engage after the stacks wear off.
Volibear.watch: If Volibear approaches with Volibear Q Thundering Smash active, watch for the stun on his empowered basic attack and wait him out beyond basic attack range. If you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, step to the side to avoid its damage and slow. When Volibear R Stormbringer is available, watch for a dive even under your turret.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first to reduce the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Also get armor to reduce the physical damage from his basic attacks. If the duel goes long, reduce Warwick's healing with Executioner's Calling.
Warwick.combo: Position yourself, Warwick, and a wall in a straight line, then slam him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. Follow with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks to hit both instances of damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock. If you need to stop his counterattack, knock him up with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict without charging it.
Warwick.escape: Don't go in just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down; check whether he can still use Warwick R Infinite Duress. Look especially for a window before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back and after Warwick E Primal Howl's fear goes off, then close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. You can immediately use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to interrupt his counterattack.
Warwick.fight: When Warwick steps forward to last-hit, find a wall angle and stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge, then trade with Poppy Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If there isn't a wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don't unload your damage; re-engage after the fear goes off.
Warwick.laning: After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to push Warwick into the wall beside the lane. If health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals the affected champion's position and increases Warwick's movement and attack speed, so recall even if you have to give up some farm.
Warwick.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock's cooldown is shorter, you can look more actively for close trades.
Warwick.teamfight: Wait for Warwick to approach your backline, then stop his dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence when he uses Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast or Warwick R Infinite Duress. Follow with Poppy E Heroic Charge to slam him into a wall and peel him off your allied damage dealers. When Warwick has a movement speed buff, Warwick R Infinite Duress can reach from far away, so during objective standoffs also watch the opposite side of the pit and the direction of brush without vision.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and can fear you, so stop dealing burst damage and back away. When Warwick engages with Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast or Warwick R Infinite Duress, stop his dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses you, you can act for its duration, so watch your distance from his engage.

XinZhao.build: Buy Executioner's Calling to reduce the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination. His main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge deals magic damage, which armor won't reduce, and Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard deals damage based on current health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health.
XinZhao.combo: Position yourself, Xin Zhao, and a wall in a straight line, then slam him into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. If he just used Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, follow this combo with Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to limit his chance to escape.
XinZhao.escape: Right after you force Xin Zhao to use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your window to engage with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you've been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's empowered basic attacks, first get out of range of his third attack. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, wait out its immunity and counterattack after it ends.
XinZhao.fight: When Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is available, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence to stop the dash. Right after he uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Fight when you have an angle to push him into a wall and stun him; if you don't, poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador and save Poppy E Heroic Charge.
XinZhao.laning: When Xin Zhao steps forward to last-hit, look for an angle to push him into the wall beside the lane. Dodge the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to the side, and save Poppy W Steadfast Presence for Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock's cooldown is shorter, look for close trades with a wall stun. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable but loses out in raw damage, so stop Xin Zhao's engage and counterattack as soon as Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: Stop Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge as he moves toward your backline with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then slam him into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. Keep some distance from your allies so Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's knockback doesn't split your formation. After Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends, look for a chance to focus Xin Zhao, and use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict if needed to interrupt a counterattack or peel an enemy off an ally.
XinZhao.watch: Dodge the later thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving to the side. If it hits, the range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge increases, so stop his dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence when he engages. If you've been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's empowered basic attacks, get out of range before his third attack knocks you up.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first to reduce the main physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade deals magic damage, which armor won't reduce. Attack speed reduction also slows the return cycles of Yasuo's basic attacks and tornado.
Yasuo.combo: Position yourself, Yasuo, and a wall in a straight line, then slam Yasuo into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you use Q first, Yasuo can walk out of the zone, so use E first when you have a wall stun angle.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws a tornado with Q Steel Tempest, his stacks reset, creating an opening to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don't assume he can't escape just because that one ability is down. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back, approach with Poppy E Heroic Charge, apply crowd control, and use R Keeper's Verdict to prevent his escape.
Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with Poppy P Iron Ambassador, then trade seriously. When Yasuo steps forward to last-hit, stun him with Poppy E Heroic Charge if you have a wall angle, then follow with Q Hammer Shock and basic attacks. If there isn't a wall angle, save E and keep W Steadfast Presence available to respond to Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the wave so it stays thin while pushing toward your side, reducing the number of minions Yasuo can use to approach with E Sweeping Blade. When Yasuo steps up to last-hit, look for an angle to push him into the wall beside the lane.
Yasuo.phase: Once you learn E Heroic Charge and Q Hammer Shock's cooldown is shorter, you can pressure Yasuo more aggressively at close range.
Yasuo.teamfight: Stand in Yasuo's path toward your backline and stop his E Sweeping Blade dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. If you get a wall angle, follow with E Heroic Charge to stun him and protect your allied damage dealers. Instead of using E to engage from far away first, use R Keeper's Verdict when needed to knock enemies up and interrupt their counterattack or push them away to split the teamfight.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so when he approaches, dodge to the side instead of only backing away. After he lands Q twice, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks enemies up, so watch its sound and effects and prepare to dodge. If Yasuo approaches across minions with E Sweeping Blade, stop his dash with Poppy W Steadfast Presence.

Yone.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave telegraphed area attacks. Yone Q Mortal Steel deals physical damage and Yone P Way of the Hunter deals magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health. Attack speed reduction slows the use cycles of Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone W Spirit Cleave.
Yone.combo: Position yourself, Yone, and a wall in a straight line, then stun him against the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. Even if Yone used Yone E Soul Unbound to engage, the stun can prevent him from returning to his body.
Yone.escape: Look for a window to engage when the tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel is down or its stacks have disappeared, and Yone can't use Yone E Soul Unbound or Yone R Fate Sealed. If only one mobility ability is down, he can escape with the others, so check first, then close the gap with Poppy E Heroic Charge. When Yone engages, save Poppy W Steadfast Presence to respond to his dash.
Yone.fight: When Yone steps forward to last-hit, find a wall angle and push him into it with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him, then trade. If there isn't a wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador. When Yone dashes, stop him with the Poppy W Steadfast Presence you've saved.
Yone.laning: Pressure Yone's health and CS during this window, but if the tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready, wait out of range until the stacks disappear. After learning Poppy E Heroic Charge, look for an angle to push him into the wall beside the lane.
Yone.phase: In the mid to late game, Poppy gets tankier but loses out in raw damage, so focus on stopping Yone as he gets stronger with items.
Yone.teamfight: Stand in Yone's path toward your backline, stop the dashes from Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, and Yone R Fate Sealed with Poppy W Steadfast Presence, then push him into a wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge to stun him. Spread out so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn't hit multiple allies, and make sure you're not standing alone at the very back of your formation in case of Yone R Fate Sealed. In a duel, interrupt his counterattack with an instant Poppy R Keeper's Verdict; when you need to split the teamfight, charge it to push enemies far away.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado engage is ready, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. If he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound and deals damage, he'll deal additional damage when he returns to his body, so heal up in advance or move out of range if your health is low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves him behind the last champion hit, so don't stand alone at the very back during teamfights.

Yorick.build: Build armor first to reduce damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers' attacks. If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites is a problem, reduce it with Executioner's Calling. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health.
Yorick.combo: Position yourself, Yorick, and a wall in a straight line, then slam Yorick into the wall with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you need to interrupt Yorick's counterattack, use Poppy R Keeper's Verdict without charging it.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility, so dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist and look for an opening to engage while Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Clear the Mist Walkers first, then set up a wall angle and catch him with Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you're trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it before attempting a risky engage.
Yorick.fight: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist and fight when Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Clear the Mist Walkers first, then stun Yorick with Poppy E Heroic Charge from a wall angle when he steps forward to last-hit. If there's no wall angle, save Poppy E Heroic Charge and poke with Poppy P Iron Ambassador.
Yorick.laning: Don't fight where Yorick has built up many graves nearby. When possible, push the lane so minions die under the enemy turret, preventing Yorick from clearing them on his side to build graves. Step forward to farm while Yorick E Mourning Mist is down.
Yorick.phase: Once you learn Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy Q Hammer Shock's cooldown is shorter, look for fights using wall angles. In the mid to late game, Poppy becomes more valuable but loses out in raw damage, so respond to Yorick's side-lane pressure and protect your allied damage dealers in teamfights.
Yorick.teamfight: Wait near your backline for enemies to engage, and stop dashing enemies with Poppy W Steadfast Presence. Use Poppy E Heroic Charge to intercept enemies attacking your allies and slam them into a wall. When you need to knock Yorick far away, charge Poppy R Keeper's Verdict and plan the direction of the knockback.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on maximum health, so dodge its trajectory. If you're trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it first. When the Maiden of the Mist starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
